SSC GD Final Cut Off and Merit List 2025

The SSC GD final cut off 2025 was released with the final result on January 15, 2026, and is force-wise, state-wise, category-wise, and gender-wise. It appears in the official result PDF write-up.

Your scorecard marks should be compared to the relevant cut-off for your category/force/state to assess selection. The merit list PDF lists roll numbers of provisionally selected candidates (around 50,047 selected against vacancies), while the scorecard provides individual marks for those who reached physical/medical stages.

(Refer to the official SSC result PDFs for exact cut-off tables - examples range from ~104 to 152+ depending on category/force.)

Selected candidates: Keep multiple printouts/PDFs of the scorecard and final result for document verification, joining, and force allocation.

Verify details (name, roll number, category, etc.) - report serious discrepancies to SSC regional offices promptly.

Non-selected candidates: Use marks for performance analysis and preparation for future SSC exams.

Download and save copies early - the window closes after the last date.

SSC GD Selection Process 2025 (Short Overview)

The process included:

  • Computer-Based Test (CBT): Four sections totaling 160 marks.
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST): Qualifying.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME)/Review Medical Examination (RME): Qualifying.
  • Final merit based on normalized CBT marks (for qualified candidates), followed by force/state allocation per vacancies and preferences.

The final scorecard reflects CBT performance post-qualifying stages, available briefly post-result.

Junior Statistical Officer (JSO) Bachelor's Degree in any subject with at least 60% marks in Mathematics at 12th level; or Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as one of the subjects at degree level.
Statistical Investigator Grade-II Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Demography, Population Studies, Operation Research, IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence.
Assistant Audit Officer / Assistant Accounts Officer Bachelor's Degree is essential. Desirable qualifications include CA, CMA, CS, M.Com, MBA (Finance), or M.B.E.
Appearing Candidates Final year candidates may apply, but they must possess the essential qualification on or before 01-08-2026.
Distance Learning Degrees Accepted only if approved by Distance Education Bureau, UGC, for Central Government employment. Proof must be produced at document verification.
BRO Posts Only male candidates are eligible for vacancies reported in Border Roads Organization.

SSC CGL 2026 – Age Limit

Age will be calculated as on 01-08-2026. The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation or Secondary Examination Certificate will be treated as final.

Age Limit (Post-wise) Date of Birth Range (Both Inclusive)
18 to 27 years 02-08-1999 to 01-08-2008
20 to 30 years 02-08-1996 to 01-08-2006
18 to 30 years 02-08-1996 to 01-08-2008
18 to 32 years (JSO) 02-08-1994 to 01-08-2008

Age Relaxation

Code Category Relaxation Beyond Upper Age Limit
01 SC / ST 5 years
02 OBC 3 years
03 PwBD (General) 10 years
04 PwBD (OBC) 13 years
05 PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years
06 Ex-Servicemen 3 years after deduction of military service from actual age
08 Defence Personnel disabled in operations (General) 3 years
09 Defence Personnel disabled in operations (SC/ST) 8 years

SSC CGL 2026 – Application Fee

Category Fee
General / OBC / EWS (Male) Rs. 100/- (Non-Refundable)
Women Candidates (All categories) NIL (Exempted)
SC / ST NIL (Exempted)
PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) NIL (Exempted)
Ex-Servicemen (ESM) eligible for reservation NIL (Exempted)

Fee must be paid online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, and RuPay debit cards. Fee once paid will not be refunded, and applications without required fee payment will be rejected.

Correction Window Fee: Rs. 200/- for first correction and Rs. 500/- for second correction. This applies to all candidates, including fee-exempt applicants.

SSC CGL 2026 – Selection Process

Selection is through a two-tier Computer Based Examination (CBE). Marks scored in CBE conducted in multiple shifts will be normalized as per the procedure published by SSC vide Notice dated 02-06-2025. There is no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores at any stage.

Tier-I: Computer Based Examination

Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time
A. General Intelligence & Reasoning 25 50 1 hour (Sectional timer: 15 min per section)
1 hour 20 min for scribe-eligible PwBD candidates
B. General Awareness 25 50
C. Quantitative Aptitude 25 50
D. English Comprehension 25 50
Total 100 200  

Tier-I consists of Objective Type / MCQ questions, set in English and Hindi (except English Comprehension). Negative marking: 0.50 marks per wrong answer.

Tier-II: Computer Based Examination

Tier-II is conducted in Paper-I, Paper-II, and Paper-III in separate shifts/days.

Paper Section / Subject Questions Marks Duration
Paper-I (Compulsory for all posts) Section-I: Mathematical Abilities + Reasoning & General Intelligence 30+30 = 60 180 Session-I: 2 hrs 15 min; Section-I: 1 hr timer
Section-II: English Language & Comprehension + General Awareness 45+25 = 70 210 1 hr timer
Section-III: Computer Knowledge Test (qualifying, mandatory) 20 60 15 min
Section-IV: Data Entry Speed Test (DEST) (qualifying, mandatory) - - Session-II: 15 min
Paper-II (JSO / Statistical Investigator only) Statistics 100 200 2 hours
Paper-III (AAO / AAcO only) General Studies (Finance and Economics) 100 200 2 hours

Negative marking in Tier-II: 1 mark per wrong answer in Section-I, II, III of Paper-I; 0.50 marks in Paper-II and Paper-III. Section-III (CKT) and Section-IV (DEST) are qualifying in nature. Candidates must qualify all sections of Paper-I separately. Higher standards of CKT and DEST are set for specific posts (CSS, MEA, AFHQ, SFIO, CBIC, Postal etc.). Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour is available for PwBD candidates eligible for scribe.

SSC CGL 2026 – Scheme of Examination & Syllabus (Brief)

Paper / Section Key Topics
Tier-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning Analogies, similarities, space visualization, problem solving, arithmetic reasoning, number series, coding-decoding, Venn diagrams, embedded figures, critical thinking, emotional intelligence, social intelligence
Tier-I: General Awareness Current events, India and neighbouring countries, History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene, General Policy, Scientific Research
Tier-I: Quantitative Aptitude Whole numbers, decimals, fractions, percentages, ratio, averages, SI/CI, profit & loss, discount, time & work, time & distance, algebra, geometry, mensuration, trigonometry, bar charts, pie charts
Tier-I: English Comprehension Grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, writing ability
Tier-II Paper-I Sec-I: Mathematical Abilities Number systems, arithmetic, algebra, geometry, mensuration, trigonometry, statistics & probability
Tier-II Paper-I Sec-II: English Language & Comprehension Vocabulary, grammar, synonyms, antonyms, idioms, sentence improvement, comprehension passages (current affairs + editorial based)
Tier-II Paper-I Sec-III: Computer Knowledge Computer basics, MS Office (Word/Excel/PowerPoint), Internet & e-mail, networking & cybersecurity basics
Tier-II Paper-II: Statistics Data collection, frequency distribution, central tendency, dispersion, correlation, regression, probability, sampling theory, statistical inference, ANOVA, time series, index numbers
Tier-II Paper-III: General Studies (Finance & Economics) Part A (Finance & Accounts, 80 marks): Financial accounting, GAAP, books of accounts, depreciation, bank reconciliation. Part B (Economics & Governance, 120 marks): Economic concepts, Indian economy, governance, financial markets, budget basics

SSC CGL 2026 – Exam Centres

The examination will be conducted through 9 SSC Regions covering all states and union territories. Candidates must choose three examination centres, in order of priority, within the same region.

Central Region: Agra, Lucknow, Prayagraj, Varanasi, Patna, Gaya Eastern Region: Kolkata, Ranchi, Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Gangtok Karnataka Kerala Region: Bengaluru, Kochi, Kozhikode, Mysuru Madhya Pradesh Region: Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Raipur North Eastern Region: Guwahati, Imphal, Shillong, Aizawl, Agartala Northern Region: Delhi, Jaipur, Dehradun North Western Region: Chandigarh, Shimla, Jammu, Srinagar, Amritsar Southern Region: Chennai, Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Coimbatore, Madurai Western Region: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Surat, Nagpur, Panaji

No request for change of centre will be entertained after submission of the application. SSC may add, cancel, or shift candidates to another centre depending on administrative requirements.

Competition Level Analysis for SSC CGL 2026

The overall competition level for SSC CGL 2026 is expected to remain very high because the examination attracts a massive number of graduate applicants every year across India. Even with around 12,256 vacancies, the effective competition ratio remains extremely tough for high-demand posts.

  1. Applicant volume is huge: SSC CGL is among the most sought-after central government exams, and premium posts receive intense preference from top scorers.
  2. Tier-I acts as the main screening stage: With negative marking and sectional timing, both speed and accuracy matter. Candidates targeting top posts generally need a very strong Tier-I score.
  3. Tier-II gets post-specific: Specialized posts like JSO and AAO attract a smaller but more qualified pool, making domain preparation more important than raw competition numbers.
  4. DEST and CKT can eliminate candidates: Although qualifying in nature, poor performance in these sections can disqualify otherwise strong candidates for certain posts.
  5. Physical standards create an extra filter: Certain Inspector and Sub Inspector posts require physical and medical fitness standards that are checked separately by user departments.

Who Should NOT Apply for SSC CGL 2026?

  1. Candidates who will not possess a Bachelor's Degree by 01-08-2026.
  2. Candidates who fall outside the age limit for all eligible posts even after applicable relaxation.
  3. OBC Creamy Layer candidates intending to claim OBC reservation.
  4. Candidates who cannot meet post-specific physical or medical standards for the posts they plan to prefer.
  5. Non-matriculate Ex-Servicemen or those who have not completed the required length of service.
  6. Candidates applying for JSO without the required Mathematics or Statistics qualification.
  7. Female candidates applying specifically for BRO vacancies, where only male candidates are eligible.
  8. Distance-learning degree holders without valid UGC-DEB approval for the relevant period.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying SSC CGL 2026

  1. Not generating a fresh OTR on the new SSC website.
  2. Using a pre-existing photograph instead of live photo capture where required.
  3. Uploading blurred or wrongly sized signature files.
  4. Selecting the wrong reservation category without valid supporting certificate.
  5. Ignoring post-specific standards before locking post preferences.
  6. Choosing JSO or AAO related preferences without being ready for Paper-II or Paper-III.
  7. Skipping Aadhaar-based authentication even when eligible.
  8. Waiting until the final date for application submission.
  9. Missing the answer key objection window after examination.
  10. Confusing the correction window fee structure.

How to Apply for SSC CGL 2026

Candidates must apply online only at https://ssc.gov.in or through the mY SSC mobile application (available on Store). No other mode of application is accepted. Candidates who have not generated OTR on the new website must do so first. Once OTR is generated on the new website, it remains valid for all future examinations on that portal.

Candidates are advised to opt for Aadhaar-based authentication during OTR. Aadhaar-authenticated candidates get significant exemptions: their applications are not rejected for photograph/signature standards, and they need not carry photo ID at the examination venue.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Generate One-Time Registration (OTR) at https://ssc.gov.in (mandatory; use Aadhaar-based authentication if possible)
  2. Complete OTR profile and lock it
  3. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF) including live photograph capture via camera
  4. Upload scanned signature (JPEG/JPG, 10–20 KB, 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm)
  5. Fill the Examination Specific Module (post preferences, exam centre choices - 3 centres within same region in order of priority)
  6. Pay application fee of Rs. 100/- online (if applicable) by 23-06-2026
  7. Preview/Print the application to verify all details before final submission
  8. Use the correction window (29-06 to 01-07-2026) if any correction is needed (chargeable)
  9. Keep printout of application and all documents for at least 3 years

Documents to Keep Ready for Document Verification (after final selection):

  • Matriculation/Secondary School Certificate (proof of date of birth)
  • Mark sheets for all years/semesters of Graduation + Provisional/Degree Certificate
  • SC/ST Certificate in prescribed format (Annexure of the notification)
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in prescribed format (Annexure-X); must be valid as on closing date of application
  • EWS Income & Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026–27 (issued based on income for FY 2025–26) in prescribed format (Annexure-XI)
  • PwBD Disability Certificate from competent authority specifying type of disability (as per Annexure-XII to XIII)
  • Ex-Serviceman discharge certificate and other relevant ESM documents
  • Equivalence certificate (for equivalent qualifications other than standard degrees)
  • DEB/UGC approval letter (for Distance Learning degree holders)
  • Certificate of proficiency in State Regional/official language (for AAO/Assistant Audit Officer State Cadre)

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in | Toll Free Helpline: 1800 309 3063

Important Instructions for SSC CGL 2026 Candidates

  • Final allotment is based on merit-cum-preference, and no alternate post will be offered if a candidate fails post-specific standards after allotment.
  • OBC candidates claiming reservation must not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of application.
  • EWS certificate must be valid for FY 2026–27 and should be based on income for FY 2025–26.
  • PwBD candidates must choose the correct sub-category in the application form because no later change is allowed.
  • Scribe rules are strict: the scribe must complete OTR, be Aadhaar-authenticated, and cannot assist more than one candidate.
  • Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour is available to eligible PwBD candidates.
  • Tentative answer keys can be challenged online by paying Rs. 100 per question within the specified period only.
  • No re-evaluation or re-checking of scores is available at any stage.
  • Candidates should preserve the application form and related documents for at least 3 years.
  • Candidature remains provisional until certificates and documents are verified by the Appointing Authority.
  • Fraudulent claims of reservation status may lead to debarment from all SSC examinations.
  • Any update in exam schedule or process will be communicated through the SSC website only.
  • Applications without the required fee, unless exempted, or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The Railway Recruitment Boards have officially released Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) No. 01/2026 for recruitment to 11127 posts of Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) under various Railway Zones, Government of India. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility, selection process, examination syllabus, medical standards, fee, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification and its annexures before applying online. The notification PDF is available on all official RRB websites.

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

These are distributed across UR, SC, ST, OBC, and EWS categories. Ex-Servicemen (ExSM) vacancies are included within the total vacancy count and are not separately additional. The post is not suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (14-06-2026). Educational/Technical qualification certificates must be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. Candidates awaiting results of their final examination for the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible to apply. The post of ALP is not suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD). Candidates who have undergone Lasik Surgery or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible for this post.

Educational Qualification

Option Details
Option A - Matriculation + ITI Matriculation / SSLC plus ITI from recognised institutions of NCVT/SCVT in the trades of Fitter, Electrician, Instrument Mechanic, Millwright/Maintenance Mechanic, Mechanic (Radio & TV), Electronics Mechanic, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Wireman, Tractor Mechanic, Armature & Coil Winder, Mechanic (Diesel), Heat Engine, Turner, Machinist, Refrigeration & Air-Conditioning Mechanic. OR Matriculation / SSLC plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship in the above trades.
Option B - Matriculation + Diploma/Degree in Engineering Matriculation / SSLC plus 3-year Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Automobile Engineering (or combination of these streams) from a recognised institution in lieu of ITI. Note: Degree in the above Engineering disciplines will also be acceptable in lieu of Diploma.

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age as on 01-07-2026. Age relaxation is available for various categories as detailed below. If a candidate is eligible for relaxation on more than one ground, only the maximum relaxation will be granted (not cumulative). SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR vacancies will not get any age relaxation. There is no fixed limit on the number of attempts - candidates can appear as long as they are within the prescribed upper age limit.

Candidates are required to pay the non-refundable recruitment fee online. Fee can be paid only through online mode - internet banking, debit/credit cards, or UPI. Applications received without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected. Candidates who appear in CBT-1 will receive a refund of their examination fee (after deducting applicable bank charges) credited to their Aadhaar-seeded bank account. Candidates whose applications are rejected, or who do not appear in CBT-1, will not receive any refund.

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 consists of five successive stages - First Stage CBT (CBT-1), Second Stage CBT (CBT-2), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), Document Verification (DV), and Medical Examination (ME). CBT-1 is a screening exam only and its marks are not counted in the final panel. The final merit list is prepared on the basis of combined marks from Part-A of CBT-2 (50% weightage) and CBAT scores (50% weightage). Negative marking of 1/3rd mark per wrong answer applies in both CBT-1 and CBT-2. There is no negative marking in CBAT.

Stage 1 - First Stage CBT (CBT-1) - Screening Only

Stage 4 & 5 - Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (ME)

Final merit list is prepared RRB-wise from candidates qualifying in CBAT, with 50% weightage to Part-A of CBT-2 marks and 50% weightage to CBAT scores. Candidates equal to the number of vacancies are shortlisted for DV and Medical Examination. In case of a tie, the older candidate is preferred; if age is also equal, alphabetical order of given name (A to Z) is applied.

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Seniority of age (older candidate preferred)
2nd Tie-Break Alphabetical order (A to Z) of given name (not surname)

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Medical Standards

The post of ALP carries Medical Standard A-1. Candidates must be physically fit in all respects with stringent vision requirements. Candidates who have undergone Lasik Surgery or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible. A Self Screening Medical Declaration Report (Part-A signed by General Physician and Part-B signed by Eye Specialist, both from a Central/State Government Hospital or Medical College) must be submitted on the CBAT exam day.

Medical Standard General Fitness Vision Standards
A-1 Physically fit in all respects (i) Distant Vision: 6/6, 6/6 without glasses with fogging test (must not accept +2D); (ii) Near Vision: Sn: 0.6, 0.6 without glasses; (iii) Must pass tests for Colour Vision, Binocular Vision, Field of Vision, Night Vision, Mesopic Vision, etc.

How to Apply for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official websites of participating RRBs (listed at Para 13.7 of the CEN). Hard copy / offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. The online portal is active from 15-05-2026 to 14-06-2026 (23:59 Hrs.). Candidates must first create an account on the RRB portal. Those who created an account for CENs notified in 2024/2025 should use the same credentials. Details filled in the "Create an Account" form (including mobile number, email ID) and the chosen RRB cannot be modified at any stage after account creation. Candidates can apply to only one RRB and submit only one application - multiple applications to the same or different RRBs will result in rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams. Aadhaar or DigiLocker authentication is strongly advised during account creation for a smoother recruitment process. A live photograph is captured during the online application; pre-existing photographs are not accepted. No documents need to be uploaded at application stage (except signature and SC/ST certificate for free travel pass, if applicable).

No TA/DA for attending interviews. No other perks or allowances beyond consolidated salary. Company's PF contribution is part of the consolidated salary. HRA component in salary may vary based on city of posting classification (calculated considering 'X' class city HRA).

Who should NOT apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold an Engineering Degree or Diploma in the relevant discipline with minimum 50% marks - this is a hard requirement for all technical posts.
  • Mechanical/Production QA/QC candidates who do not have ASNT Level-II certification in NDT methods (UT, RT, MPT, PT) - this is mandatory and non-negotiable.
  • Candidates who do not have the prescribed minimum post-qualification experience as on 30.04.2026 - experience counted is post-PQ only.
  • Candidates exceeding the maximum age limit for their respective grade and discipline (Degree or Diploma holder category) as on 30.04.2026.
  • Candidates looking for a permanent government job - this is a Fixed Term Contract with no liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage; total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting can be at any CEIL office or project site across India at the discretion of management.
  • OBC candidates from creamy layer - only OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.
  • PwD candidates with less than 40% disability - minimum 40% disability is required for PwD relaxation benefits.
  • Candidates without a valid and functional email ID that can remain active for at least 24 months from date of application - all communications will be via email only.
  • Candidates for the Safety Officer post without a Degree/Diploma in Industrial Safety in addition to the engineering degree - both are mandatory.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Not checking ASNT Level-II certification status before applying for Mechanical/Production QA/QC posts - it is mandatory and absence will disqualify the application.
  • Miscalculating experience years - experience must be post-qualification (after engineering degree/diploma) and is counted as on 30.04.2026, not the date of application.
  • Applying with CGPA/OGPA without converting to equivalent percentage - candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and be ready to produce documentary proof at interview.
  • Applying through any mode other than CEIL's official recruitment portal (https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/) - applications through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • Providing an incorrect or inactive email ID - all communications including interview/test intimation will be via email only; CEIL will not be responsible for loss of communication due to invalid email.
  • Applying for Grade-II posts in Marketing, SCM, or Office Management without adequate experience in those specific functional areas - engineering qualification alone is not sufficient; relevant functional experience is mandatory.
  • Not keeping track of CEIL's official website www.ceil.co.in - any change in last date or other schedule will be communicated only through the website, not separately.
  • Attending the interview without carrying all original documents - absence of any required document (age proof, marksheets, experience certificates, salary slip, category certificate) will result in disqualification from interview.
  • Canvassing in any form - this will immediately result in disqualification.
  • Not preparing 5 copies of the Annexure (CV format) - shortlisted candidates will need to bring 5 copies of the Annexure, which will be sent only to shortlisted candidates by CEIL.

How to Apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only through CEIL's official recruitment portal. Applications received through any other mode shall not be entertained. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date. Applications found incomplete or received after the due date are liable to be rejected.

Documents Required at the time of Interview:

  • Proof of Age (10th / Matriculation certificate)
  • Educational and Professional Qualifications (all marksheets & certificates)
  • Service Certificate of past employment, proof of date of joining & continuity in present organization (if applicable) & latest salary slip
  • Medical Certificate for PwD (if applicable) with photograph from competent authority, confirming minimum 40% disability
  • SC / ST / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate from competent authority (OBC certificate must clearly state non-creamy layer status)
  • EWS certificate from competent authority
  • 5 copies of duly filled Annexure / CV (format sent to shortlisted candidates only)

Apply Online at: https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/

For further updates: Visit www.ceil.co.in → Careers section

Important Instructions for CEIL Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This is a Fixed Term Contract engagement - purely on a temporary basis. It does not carry any liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage. Total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Initial appointment is for one year, extendable (if required) for another 36 months or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Selected candidates will initially be posted at CEIL Head Office, Navi Mumbai but may be posted at any CEIL office or project site anywhere in India at management's discretion. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India need apply.
  • No perks or allowances other than the consolidated salary are payable. In case of extension beyond one year, increment @ 3% per year will be considered for the next 2 years.
  • Fixed Term Personnel must take Medical Insurance of minimum ₹2,00,000/- for self; the premium will be reimbursed by CEIL.
  • CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grade in Degree must be converted to equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and documentary proof will be required at interview.
  • No TA/DA will be given for attending interviews.
  • Candidates must be of sound health; Medical Fitness Certificate from Government Hospital / Company Nominated Hospital is required at the time of joining (expense reimbursable on original receipt).
  • Contractual engagement may be terminated by CEIL at any time at its sole discretion without assigning any reason if performance/conduct is found unsatisfactory.
  • For termination during currency of contract, one month's written notice or one month's consolidated pay in lieu thereof shall be given by either party.
  • Reservation and relaxation for PwDs shall be as per GOI guidelines. Persons with 40% or more disabilities are eligible.
  • Experience prescribed is relaxable at the discretion of CEIL for SC/ST candidates.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Number of vacancies indicated are only tentative; CEIL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter selection/recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • CEIL also reserves the right to reject any candidature without assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment will be under the jurisdiction of Mumbai court only.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date, i.e. 01-06-2026. Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of original documents before joining.

Criteria Details
Nationality Indian Nationals only.
Institute Location Qualification must be from a recognized Institute/University which is functional and operational either in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh State.
Educational Qualification As prescribed discipline-wise; obtained through Full-time Regular course only. Qualifications via Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning are not eligible.
Qualification Passing Date Candidate should not have passed Graduation/Diploma/ITI prior to June 2022.
Prior Apprenticeship / Experience Candidates who have undergone Apprenticeship earlier, are currently pursuing Apprenticeship Training, or have 1 year or more of job experience are summarily ineligible.
Higher Qualification Candidates possessing higher qualification over and above the prescribed qualification are not eligible.
OBC Status Only OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.
PwBD Eligibility PwBD candidates must submit a valid disability certificate as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017 from the competent authority.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Age Limit

Age is calculated as on the cut-off date 01-06-2026. Candidates must have been born on or between 01-06-2000 and 01-06-2008 (i.e. minimum 18 years and maximum 26 years). Standard age relaxations are applicable only for reserved category slots.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

Selection will be made purely on the basis of merit drawn from qualifying examination marks, followed by document scrutiny and a mandatory medical test. No written examination will be conducted by NCL for this recruitment.

Stage 1 – Merit List Preparation

For Graduate and Diploma positions, merit is drawn on the basis of marks scored in the qualifying Graduation/Diploma examination. For ITI Trade positions, merit is based on the average of passing percentage in Matriculation and the respective National/State Trade Certificate. Candidates are arranged in descending order of marks. In case of a tie, date of birth (older candidate preferred) and then alphabetical order of name will be applied.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny

Shortlisted candidates based on merit will be called to appear with all original certificates for scrutiny. Date and venue will be notified on nclcil.in and through NATS/NAPS portal or email. Failure to appear or produce valid documents within the stipulated date and time will result in cancellation of candidature.

Stage 3 – Medical Examination

Final offer for Apprenticeship Training is subject to clearing the Medical Test as per prescribed standards under the Mines Rules 1955. A fitness certificate from the medical officer of a Government Hospital (rank not less than Assistant Civil Surgeon) in the prescribed format (Annexure-3) must be produced. The Medical Fitness certificate must be issued after the date of release of this Notification.

Who should NOT apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training earlier or are currently pursuing Apprenticeship in any industry.
  • Candidates with 1 year or more of job experience.
  • Candidates who have passed their qualifying degree/diploma/ITI before June 2022.
  • Candidates who possess qualifications higher than the prescribed qualification for the applied discipline.
  • Candidates whose qualifying institution is not functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Candidates whose qualifications were obtained through Part-time, Correspondence, or Distance Learning mode.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer.
  • Candidates who submit multiple applications - multiple applications will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates who are unable to produce a valid Medical Fitness certificate as per Mines Rules 1955.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Not pre-registering on the NATS portal (for Graduate/Diploma) or NAPS portal (for Trade/ITI) before applying - without a valid Enrolment ID, the application cannot be completed.
  • Applying for more than one discipline - multiple applications will lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Entering incorrect percentage/marks scored or maximum marks in the online form - candidature will be cancelled if found incorrect during scrutiny.
  • Not checking that the qualifying institution is functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Uploading blurred or unclear photograph or signature in black ink.
  • Not having an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least one year for future communication.
  • Rounding off the passing percentage - NCL will not consider rounding off (49.99% will be treated as less than 50%).
  • Not taking a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference.

How to Apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27

Candidates must apply online only. Graduate and Diploma Apprentice candidates must first enrol on the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and Trade Apprentice candidates must enrol on the NAPS portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. After successful registration, a registration number (Enrolment ID) will be generated, following which the candidate must apply for the NCL positions through the respective portal.

Documents/Details required at the time of Online Application:

  • Valid NATS/NAPS Enrolment ID (registration reference).
  • Scanned colour photograph and scanned signature in black ink (as per portal specifications).
  • Date of Birth as per Matriculation certificate.
  • Academic details - total marks scored and maximum marks in qualifying degree/diploma/ITI trade.
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in prescribed format (Annexure-1), if applicable.
  • PwBD disability certificate as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017 (Annexure-2), if applicable.
  • Address for correspondence and permanent address.

Candidates must save and preserve a hard copy as well as soft copy of the finally submitted online application for future reference. No paper-based or postal applications will be accepted.

Apply Online (Graduate/Diploma) at: https://nats.education.gov.in

Apply Online (Trade/ITI) at: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

For assistance, candidates may email the HRD Department, NCL at [email protected] or visit Menu > Career > Apprenticeship Training section on the NCL official website www.nclcil.in.

Important Instructions for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Candidates

  • Online applications are open from 01-06-2026 to 15-06-2026 through NATS/NAPS portals only.
  • A candidate may apply for any one notified position only - multiple applications will lead to disqualification.
  • Information pertaining to Date of Birth, Caste Category, and Qualification once entered in the online application shall be considered final - no alteration will be permitted at later stages.
  • Stipend for Graduate and Diploma Apprentices is inclusive of the Government of India share paid through DBT; Trade Apprentice stipend will be paid directly by NCL.
  • Stipend will be paid directly into the AADHAAR-linked bank account of the Apprenticeship Trainee as per the signed contract.
  • Apprenticeship Training is purely temporary and statutory in nature - it does not confer any right or claim for regular employment in NCL.
  • Apprentices are eligible for 11 days Casual Leave and 15 days Medical Leave per year of training.
  • Engagement hours are between 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
  • Apprentices will be covered under the Workmen Compensation Act, 1923 for any accident during training.
  • No accommodation, fooding/lodging, or transport will be provided during the training period.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in document scrutiny or post-scrutiny processes.
  • Canvassing in any manner at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Any dispute will be subject to courts/tribunals of Singrauli, MP only.
  • Dates mentioned in the notification are tentative and subject to alteration/amendment.

Eligibility Criteria for Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator

Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 18 years as on the last date of application.
  • Upper age limit, if any, will be as per CSC/concerned guidelines.

Educational Qualification

Candidate must have any one of the following qualifications:

  • 12th / Intermediate / Senior Secondary, or
  • Matriculation / 10th with 2 years ITI, or
  • Matriculation / 10th with 3 years Polytechnic Diploma.

Aadhaar Certification

  • Candidate should possess a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI.

Other Skills

  • Candidate should have basic computer skills.
  • Familiarity with Aadhaar enrolment/update software and biometric devices will be preferred.

Remuneration

Aadhaar Supervisor Exam

Candidates can apply for and take the Aadhaar Supervisor Exam through the official exam portal: Aadhaar Supervisor Exam.

After submitting the exam application, an authorization request goes to the concerned State Team. Once the State Team approves the request, the candidate becomes eligible to appear in the Aadhaar Supervisor Exam.

Aadhaar LMS Certification

LMS ID and password will be created and approved for eligible candidates. After approval, candidates can take the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the UIDAI e-learning portal: Aadhaar LMS Certification.

Other Terms and Conditions

  • The engagement is purely on contract basis for a period of 1 year only.
  • CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage.
  • Only candidates with valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificates are eligible.
  • VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are not eligible to apply for these positions.

  • Follow the application instructions issued by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd for the respective state/district.
  • Keep all required documents and Aadhaar certification details ready while applying.

Interview Travel Reimbursement (Grade F) Economy class air fare on production of tickets and boarding passes

Who should NOT apply for Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates whose post-qualification work experience does not meet the minimum 09 years (or 13/17 years for Economist Grade E/F) as on 28-06-2026 - even one day short disqualifies.
  • Candidates whose experience has been acquired through academic, research, fellowship, JRF/SRF, PhD scholar, project-based, consultancy, internship, apprenticeship or part-time/ad-hoc roles - all such experience is explicitly excluded from "Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience" under this notification.
  • Candidates applying for Deputy Chief Geophysicist (GEOP-04) with a PG in Computational Seismology or similar excluded streams - the notification specifically disqualifies such qualifications.
  • Private sector candidates from companies with an annual turnover of less than Rs. 500 Crores - they are not eligible under OIL's experience recognition policy.
  • Candidates in regular Government/PSU employment who do not have minimum 2 years of service in the next lower pay scale equivalent as prescribed in Table-III of the notification - they will be screened out at document verification.
  • Candidates whose educational qualification nomenclature does not exactly match what is prescribed - OIL has explicitly stated that no variation in qualification nomenclature will be accepted.
  • Candidates who cannot produce NOC from their current Government/PSU employer at the time of Personal Interview - without NOC they will not be allowed to appear for the interview and travel fares will not be reimbursed.
  • Candidates unable to pass Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME) as per OIL's physical fitness standards - final appointment will be cancelled if declared medically unfit.
  • Candidates whose percentage is arrived at by rounding off - OIL explicitly states rounding off of percentage is not allowed for eligibility determination.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026?

  • Not uploading a separate document detailing roles and responsibilities for each employment claimed - beyond the experience certificate, OIL mandates a separate role/responsibility document from each employer; missing this leads to rejection of experience claim.
  • Uploading only an offer letter for past employment without also submitting two mandatory supporting documents from the prescribed list (last pay slip, increment letter, promotion order, PF statement, or appointment letter) - non-submission of both supporting documents can lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Claiming CGPA as percentage without converting to percentage as per university/institute norms - CGPA must be converted and the equivalent percentage clearly mentioned; rounding off is not permitted.
  • Using the same email ID or mobile number as another candidate - the same email/mobile cannot be shared between candidates; duplicate details will cause registration failure.
  • Submitting multiple applications and not ensuring the one with the highest Application Sequence Number is complete - OIL will only process the application with the highest sequence number for each post.
  • Uploading documents exceeding 5 MB per file or 200 MB total - applications with oversized attachments may face technical rejection.
  • Not applying for each post separately - candidates eligible for multiple posts must register and submit separate applications for each post.
  • Candidates applying for Economist post not specifying the Grade (D/E/F) they are applying for clearly - eligibility and experience requirements differ for each grade and applications are scrutinized accordingly.
  • OBC candidates submitting an outdated Non-Creamy Layer certificate - the NCL certificate must clearly state that the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer as defined by Government of India for Central Government services; an old or vague certificate will not be accepted.
  • Being misled by fraudulent job offers - OIL has specifically warned that unscrupulous individuals are issuing fake appointment letters; all genuine communications come only from the official OIL website and registered email ID.

How to Apply for Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply online only through the OIL website. No other mode of application will be accepted. Printouts of online applications should NOT be sent to OIL by post or hand.

Step I – Sign Up / Registration: Visit https://www.oil-india.com/advertisement-list and click on "Advertisement for Recruitment of Officers in Grade D/E/F in OIL." Select the post, fill in personal details, valid email ID and mobile number. Complete OTP authentication. Note down the Application Number and password received on registered email/mobile.

Step II – Complete Application Form: Fill in Basic Details, Address, Qualification Details, Eligibility Details, Experience Details. Upload photo, signature and scanned certificates. Click "Submit" to finalize.

Documents to be Uploaded Online:

  • Recent passport size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg/PNG format, not older than 3 weeks)
  • Signature on white paper with black ink pen (jpg/jpeg/PNG format)
  • Birth Certificate or Matriculation/10th Admit Card/Pass Certificate/Marksheet showing date of birth - no other document accepted for age proof
  • Degree/Diploma certificates and mark sheets for all academic years (or provisional certificate if degree not yet issued)
  • Experience Letter/Service Certificate from each employer on official letterhead (with name, designation, dates of joining and relieving)
  • Separate document from each employer explicitly detailing roles and responsibilities performed
  • Any two supporting documents per employment from the prescribed list: last pay slip, annual increment letter, promotion/transfer order, PF statement, or offer/appointment letter (for past employment); or identity card, increment letter, promotion/transfer order, PF statement (for current employment)
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in Government of India prescribed format, if applicable
  • Valid NCL certificate for OBC candidates, if applicable
  • Valid EWS Income & Assets Certificate in Government of India format, if applicable
  • Valid Disability Certificate (min. 40% disability) for PwBD candidates, if applicable
  • Valid Discharge Book/Service and Release Certificate for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable
  • Domicile Certificate (J&K, 1980–1989) for age relaxation claim, if applicable
  • CGPA/Grade to percentage conversion certificate from university/institute, if marks are in CGPA/Grade format
  • NOC from current employer (for Government/PSU employees - mandatory at PI stage)

Apply Online at: https://www.oil-india.com/advertisement-list

Important Instructions for Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • The Cut-off date for all matters - age, experience, qualification - is 28-06-2026.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for PI; shortlisting criteria may be raised if the number of applications is large.
  • Candidates in permanent Government/PSU employment must produce a valid NOC from their employer at the time of PI - without this they will not be permitted to appear and travel fares will not be reimbursed.
  • Appointment of provisionally selected candidates is subject to medical fitness as per OIL's Physical Fitness criteria; candidature is cancelled if declared unfit by OIL's Medical Board.
  • Provisionally selected candidates will serve a probationary period of 1 year and will be confirmed in writing after successful completion.
  • Any false information or document at any stage - even after joining - will result in cancellation/termination and blacklisting from all future OIL recruitments.
  • All future announcements for this vacancy will be published only on www.oil-india.com - not on any other website or medium.
  • OIL has warned all candidates about fraudulent fake appointment letters being circulated by unscrupulous elements - OIL does not authorize any person/organization outside OIL to offer jobs on its behalf.
  • Any dispute regarding recruitment under this advertisement will be under the jurisdiction of Dibrugarh District Court only.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • OIL strives to have a gender-balanced workforce and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

AWEIL Recruitment 2026 - Post-wise Scope of Work

Each post carries a defined scope of responsibility at AWEIL Corporate Office, Kanpur. The selected candidate may also be deputed to any AWEIL unit or Government office as per requirement.

Who should NOT apply for AWEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates whose age exceeds the upper limit for their respective post as on 15-06-2026, even by one day.
  • Legal Expert applicants who do not hold LLB with minimum 60% marks or who are not registered in Bar Council anywhere in India.
  • Executive (Official Language) applicants who do not have a Master's degree meeting the Hindi-English language medium combinations specified and who do not have 03 years' translation/terminological work experience.
  • Executive (Corporate Communication) applicants who do not possess a two-year Master's Degree or two-year Diploma (with minimum 65%) in Mass Communication/Journalism/Advertising & Public Relations specifically - a general MBA or arts degree does not qualify.
  • Jr. Executive (HR) applicants who do not hold a Bachelor's Degree specifically in HR/Personnel/IR/PM & IR with minimum 60% marks - general graduates with HR experience are not eligible.
  • Sr. Manager (IT) applicants who do not hold a full-time regular degree (part-time, distance or correspondence degrees in engineering/MCA do not qualify).
  • Candidates whose post-qualification experience is below the minimum years required for the respective post.
  • Candidates seeking permanent employment or PSU absorption - the contract explicitly states no right of extension or absorption in the company.
  • Government/PSU employees who cannot obtain an NOC from their employer - NOC is mandatory at the time of interview and candidature will be cancelled without it.
  • Executive (Corporate Communication) candidates who have already applied against previous advertisement AWEIL/02/2025 - the notification explicitly advises such candidates not to apply again.
  • Candidates who cannot submit hard copy applications via Speed Post/Courier - online or email applications are not accepted under any circumstances.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying AWEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Not writing the post name clearly on the envelope as specified - e.g. "APPLICATION FOR THE POST LEGAL EXPERT" must appear on the envelope; wrong or missing post name can cause misdirection or rejection.
  • Pasting both passport photographs instead of pasting one (4.4 cm x 5.8 cm) on the application form and only attaching (not pasting) the second one - the notification specifically differentiates between the two.
  • Not writing the full name on the back of both passport photographs for identification purposes.
  • Name or spelling mismatch between the application/bio-data and educational/professional qualification certificates - this leads to outright cancellation.
  • Using an email ID or mobile number that may become inactive before the interview date - all communications including interview call will be sent to these details only.
  • OBC candidates applying for Jr. Executive (HR) without a valid, current non-creamy layer OBC certificate - category cannot be changed later.
  • Not filling 'N/A' in columns that are not applicable - leaving columns blank leads to incomplete application rejection.
  • Sending applications by ordinary post or hand delivery instead of Speed Post or Courier - AWEIL takes no responsibility for delay or loss in transit.
  • Govt./PSU employees routing applications directly instead of through proper channel - such applications are summarily rejected.
  • Applying for a post where you meet partial experience but not the specific domain - e.g. general legal experience without corporate/PSU/Govt. sector background for Legal Expert, or general translation experience outside Govt./PSU/University institutions for Official Language Executive.

How to Apply for AWEIL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply in Hard Copy only using the prescribed application format for the respective post. The application form can be downloaded from the official AWEIL website (www.aweil.in) or the DoO(C&S) website (ddpdoo.gov.in). Completed applications must be sent via Speed Post or Courier only - no other mode is accepted.

Send Application To:

Director (HR), Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited, Ordnance Factory Kanpur (OFC) Premises, Kalpi Road, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh – 208009

Documents to be Submitted Along with Application:

  • Self-attested copy of age proof - Birth Certificate or 10th Class Certificate
  • Self-attested copies of all educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Graduation level onwards)
  • Self-attested copies of all experience certificates and documentary proof of experience
  • Self-attested copy of Bar Council Registration Certificate (for Legal Expert post)
  • Self-attested copy of caste certificate in prescribed format (for OBC candidates applying for Jr. Executive HR)
  • Aadhar Card Number and PAN Number details (mandatory in application form)
  • No Objection Certificate from current employer (for Govt./PSU employees - mandatory at interview stage)

Documents to be Produced at the Time of Interview:

  • All original documents of educational qualifications and experience for verification
  • Two self-attested copies of all documents
  • Original NOC from employer (for Govt./PSU/Quasi-Govt. employees)
  • For candidates from Govt./PSU/private sector who are finally selected - document evidencing acceptance of resignation from previous employer (mandatory before joining)

Important Instructions for AWEIL Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • The appointment is purely temporary and on contract basis - it does not confer any right or claim of extension or absorption in AWEIL.
  • The contract can be terminated by AWEIL by giving 1 month's notice or payment of 1 month's salary in lieu thereof. Candidates wishing to leave must give 3 months' notice or pay 3 months' salary in lieu.

Important Instructions for EIL Special Recruitment Drive 2026 Candidates

  • PwD candidates — persons with 40% or more permanent nature of disability only are eligible to apply under PwD category.
  • Furnishing of wrong/false information will be a disqualification and EIL will not be responsible for any consequences thereof.
  • EIL reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process without assigning any reason.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Delhi.

Stage 2 - Recruitment Test / Interview

SAIL Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for Young Professional engagements will be based on: (i) Application scrutiny for eligibility; (ii) Computer Based Test (CBT)/Aptitude/General Management/Psychometric Test if applications received are more than 5 times the requirement (shortlisting ratio 1:3 based on test performance); (iii) Personal Interview if applications are fewer than 5 times the requirement - all eligible candidates called for interview. Final merit list is prepared with CBT:Interview weightage of 80:20. A discipline-wise panel (1:1 ratio of selected to waitlisted) will be maintained for 6 months for non-joining/early exit cases.

Stage 1 - Application Scrutiny

All applications received by the closing date (06-06-2026) will be scrutinized for fulfilment of eligibility criteria. Candidature is purely provisional and will be verified against original documents at the time of Interview, Pre-Employment Medical Examination, and Joining.

Stage 2 - Computer Based Test (CBT) / Shortlisting Test (if applicable)

If applications received against any engagement exceed 5 times the requirement, a Computer Based Test/Aptitude/General Management/Psychometric Test or any standard test/exam will be organized. Shortlisting for interview will be in the ratio of 1:3 based on test performance. If the cut-off marks are obtained by more candidates, all of them will be called for interview. CBT carries 80% weightage in the final merit list.

Stage 3 - Personal Interview

Shortlisted/all eligible candidates will be called for personal interview at centres spread across the country. Interview carries 20% weightage in the final merit list. No request for change in date or centre of interview will be entertained. Candidates from PSU/Govt. Departments/Autonomous Bodies must produce NOC in original from the employer at the time of interview.

Stage 4 - Pre-Employment Medical Examination & Joining

Joining of selected candidates is subject to medical fitness. Selected candidates must join within 30 days from the offer of engagement - no extension permitted. Every selected candidate must enter into a Contract for Service agreement with the respective SAIL Plant before joining.

How to Apply for SAIL Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Eligible and interested candidates must apply online only through SAIL's official Careers website: www.sail.co.in (Careers) or http://sailcareers.com. No other mode of application is accepted. Candidates must first complete One-Time Registration (if new user) and then proceed to fill the application. Once all required details are entered and the application is confirmed, no editing will be allowed. After confirmation, candidates must pay the Registration & Processing Fee online, submit the application, and download the Registration Slip with Application ID.

Documents to be Scanned and Uploaded (PDF format, max 300 KB each):

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph in .jpg/.jpeg format (max 50 KB, white background, no sunglasses/dark glasses)
  • Photograph of running signature in .jpg/.jpeg format (max 20 KB - not capital letters, individual alphabets, or initials)
  • Matriculation certificate showing Date of Birth
  • Pass Certificate of XII, B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech./Ph.D. or any other relevant qualification
  • Experience certificate(s) showing relevant post-qualification experience from employer
  • NOC from present employer (if employed under PSUs/Autonomous Bodies/Govt. Department)
  • Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, or Voter ID)
  • Address Proof (Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card or others)
  • CGPA/SGPA to percentage conversion certificate/chart/formulae (if applicable - optional)
  • Equivalence certificate for foreign university qualifications (if applicable)

After applying online, candidates must download the system-generated Registration Slip with Application ID and retain it for future reference. All subsequent communications - CBT Admit Card, Interview call letters, Pre-Employment Medical Examination letter, final selection intimation - will be sent via email/SMS only. SAIL will not be responsible for non-receipt due to wrong/invalid email ID/mobile number.

Apply Online at: https://sailcareers.com/sail2026yp/ 

Important Instructions for SAIL Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This engagement is purely of temporary nature (Contract for Service) and shall NOT create any right for regular appointment on any ground whatsoever. It does NOT create an employer-employee relationship with SAIL.
  • Initial tenure is 3 years, extendable up to 2 additional years (one year at a time) based on satisfactory performance - maximum total period is 5 years.
  • Performance is reviewed annually; tenure extension is at the discretion of the Company based on performance and eligibility.
  • During the first 6 months, either party can terminate with 7 days' notice without notice pay. Beyond 6 months, 1 month's notice or 1 month's retainership fee in lieu is required by either party.
  • Absence for 15 consecutive days without prior written sanction may lead to immediate termination without notice.
  • Self-insurance (Medical/Life/Health/Accident) is mandatory for all Young Professionals.
  • No other perks, allowances, loans, advances, PRP, PF, Pension, Gratuity, or terminal benefits are payable beyond those specifically mentioned in the advertisement.
  • In the event of death, injury or illness attributable to performance of services, neither the Young Professional nor family members shall be entitled to any compensation from SAIL.
  • Candidates must join within 30 days from the offer of engagement - no extension is permitted on any grounds.
  • Every selected candidate must sign a Contract for Service agreement with the respective SAIL Plant before joining. Engagement without a signed agreement is null and void.
  • Candidates must furnish an undertaking/declaration regarding good moral character and absence of criminal conviction or pending judicial proceedings at the time of joining.
  • SAIL reserves the right to carry out pre-engagement verification of antecedents and credentials including general character. Adverse reports may lead to termination without notice.
  • Examination centres allotted are binding - no request for change of examination centre will be entertained.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Asansol/Durgapur, West Bengal.
  • SAIL-ISP/DSP/ASP reserves the right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the engagement process at any stage without notice or reason, without any liability to compensate applicants.
  • All corrigendum/addendum/notices will be published only on www.sail.co.in - candidates must check the website periodically.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application i.e. 12-06-2026 (1800 Hrs). Mere possession of minimum essential qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for interview - UPSC may shortlist candidates based on desirable qualifications, higher educational qualifications, higher experience, or by holding a Recruitment Test. All candidates in Government service (permanent/temporary, other than casual/adhoc/daily wages) must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department in writing that they have applied.

Criteria Details
Citizenship Citizen of India, or subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or Tibetan refugee (came before 01-01-1962 intending to permanently settle in India), or person of Indian origin migrated from Pakistan/Burma/Sri Lanka/East African countries intending to permanently settle in India - subject to Government of India eligibility certificate where applicable.
Educational Qualification Varies by post - from Bachelor's degree in Engineering to Master's degree/Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Refer post-wise details in the notification.
Experience Varies by post - from nil to 10 years of relevant experience. Part-time/daily wages/visiting/guest faculty experience will NOT be counted. Refer post-wise details.
OBC - Non Creamy Layer OBC candidates must submit a declaration that they do not belong to the Creamy Layer. The closing date of receipt of Online Recruitment Application is the crucial date for OBC non-creamy layer status.
PwBD Eligibility PwBD candidates with disability not less than 40% are eligible. Those with "likely to improve" (temporary disability) are NOT eligible for reservation. Candidates can apply for suitable posts even if not reserved for PwBD - but will be considered by general merit standard without relaxation.
Government Employees Persons already in regular government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department in writing of their application. Casual/adhoc/daily wages/hourly paid/contract employees should apply directly without such declaration.
Equivalent Qualification Candidates claiming equivalent qualifications must produce order/letter indicating the Authority (with number and date) under which it has been treated as equivalent; otherwise the application will be rejected.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Age limits are post-specific and are calculated as on the closing date for submission of online recruitment application i.e. 12-06-2026. The age limits shown in the advertisement are the normal limits for UR/EWS candidates. Standard age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), and PwBD (10 years) for vacancies reserved/suitable for them. OBC/SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts are not entitled to age relaxation.

Category Age Relaxation
SC / ST 5 years relaxation (for vacancies reserved for them)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation (for vacancies reserved for them)
PwBD (General) 10 years relaxation (for vacancies reserved/suitable for them)
Ex-Servicemen / Commissioned Officers including ECOs/SSCOs As per prescribed proforma from competent authority - as per Concessions & Relaxations section of UPSC notification
Central / UT Government Employees/Servants As per prescribed proforma from competent authority issued after date of advertisement

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Application fee is to be paid online only and is non-refundable. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstance nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination or selection. Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected without any representation being entertained.

Category Application Fee
General / OBC / EWS (Male candidates) Rs. 25/- (Non-Refundable) - via Visa/Master/Rupay Credit/Debit Card/UPI/Internet Banking
SC / ST / PwBD / Women (all communities) NIL (Exempted from fee payment)

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be made by Recruitment by Selection - through Interview or Recruitment Test followed by Interview as decided by UPSC on a post-by-post basis. In the event of a large number of applications, UPSC will adopt shortlisting criteria including desirable qualifications, higher educational qualifications, higher experience, experience before/after essential qualification, or by conducting a Recruitment Test. The summoning of candidates for interview conveys no assurance of selection. Appointment orders will be issued by the respective Ministry.

Stage 1 - Application Scrutiny and Shortlisting

All applications are scrutinized for eligibility. If applications are large in number, UPSC may shortlist based on: (a) Desirable Qualifications; (b) higher educational qualifications; (c) higher relevant experience; (d) counting experience before/after essential qualification; (e) invoking experience even where not mentioned as EQ/DQ; or (f) by holding a Recruitment Test. Candidates should mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum qualifications.

Stage 2 - Recruitment Test (RT) followed by Interview (wherever applicable)

If selection is made by Recruitment Test followed by Interview, candidates must achieve minimum suitability at both stages. Minimum interview marks: UR – 50, OBC – 45, SC/ST/PH – 40 (out of 100 total interview marks). Minimum marks for Recruitment Test shall be decided by UPSC on a case-by-case basis.

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Selected candidates must be in sound bodily health and must undergo medical examination and satisfy medical authority as required by the Government.

How to Apply for UPSC Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply online only at https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. The UPSC online portal has four modules: Account Creation, Universal Registration (URN), Common Application Form (CAF), and Post/Vacancy-specific module. The first three modules can be filled at any time; the fourth (vacancy-specific) module must be filled during the application window. Candidates who have already registered and have a URN can directly log in and fill the vacancy-specific module. Candidates are strongly advised to use Aadhaar Card as the ID document for seamless verification. Applications once submitted are final - no correction/alteration/modification is permitted after submission. Candidates must take a printout of the finally submitted application and carry it along with original documents if called for interview.

Documents to be Uploaded at the time of Online Application:

  • Live photograph captured via webcam/camera during CAF filling (mandatory)
  • Scanned recent passport-size photograph (as per instructions on UPSC website)
  • Scanned signature (three signatures one below the other on plain white paper, black ink)
  • Matriculation/10th Standard certificate or marksheet as proof of Date of Birth
  • Degree/Diploma certificate as proof of educational qualification; if not available, provisional certificate + all year marksheets
  • Experience Certificate(s) in prescribed format from Head(s) of Organisation(s) - mentioning duration, basic pay, consolidated pay, and nature of duties
  • Caste/Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC) in prescribed proforma from Competent Authority
  • OBC Non-Creamy Layer declaration in prescribed format
  • EWS certificate in prescribed proforma
  • PwBD Disability Certificate from Medical Board constituted by Central/State Government
  • Age relaxation certificate for Ex-Servicemen/Central/UT Government Employees in prescribed proforma
  • Order/letter for equivalent qualification (if applicable) citing Authority with number and date
  • Name change documents (if applicable - marriage certificate/divorce decree/affidavit as per situation)
  • Documentary support for any other claim made (Professional Registration, Publications, GATE/NET, etc.)

Printout of the finally submitted Online Recruitment Application must be retained - candidates will need to bring it to the interview along with original certificates. Candidates are NOT required to send printouts or documents by post or by hand to UPSC.

Apply Online at: https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/

For queries: Helpline No. 011-24041001 or 011-40303444 | Email: [email protected] (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM on all working days during the application window).

Important Instructions for UPSC Advertisement No. 05/2026 Candidates

  • Online applications open from 23-05-2026 and close on 12-06-2026 at 1800 Hrs - candidates must apply well in advance without waiting for the closing date.
  • All candidates must enter correct and active email addresses - all correspondence including interview schedules will be communicated only through the registered email ID.
  • Applications once submitted are final - no correction/alteration/modification in any field is allowed after submission. No withdrawal of applications is permitted.
  • The date for determining eligibility in every respect is the closing date for submission of online recruitment application (12-06-2026).
  • Filling wrong information may lead to rejection through computer-based shortlisting apart from debarment by the Commission.
  • Face authentication will be mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/Interview Hall - candidates must enter well in time for face authentication and frisking.
  • Mobile phones (even in switched-off mode), pagers, smart watches, pen drives, cameras, Bluetooth devices, or any electronic/communication device are strictly banned at the examination/interview venue. Violation leads to disciplinary action including ban from future examinations/recruitment.
  • Candidates must not bring valuables or bags to the venue - no arrangement for safe-keeping will be made and UPSC will not be responsible for any loss.
  • The Commission will contribute towards interview travelling expenses at Second Class Mail railway fare rate by shortest route - candidates will be informed of details when called for interview.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Summoning for interview conveys no assurance of selection - appointment orders will be issued by the respective Ministry.
  • UPSC may grant higher initial pay to candidates adjudged meritorious in the interview.
  • The Commission does not enter into correspondence with candidates about reasons for non-selection - no interim enquiry about results will be entertained.
  • Prescribed proforma for various certificates are available at https://upsc.gov.in under Recruitment → Forms of Certificates.

Sarkari Job (सरकारी नौकरी) refers to government employment in India — jobs offered by central government departments, state governments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), banks, railways, defence forces, and other government-funded organisations. These jobs offer permanent employment, fixed salary as per 7th Pay Commission, pension, medical benefits, and unmatched job security.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.

How to Download SSC GD Admit Card 2026?

  • Visit the official SSC website: ssc.gov.in
  • Click on the “Admit Card” section or login portal
