Other Benefits on Placement Transport Allowance, HRA / Housing, Site Location Allowance, Leave Travel Allowance, Medical Facility (CHSS), Educational facilities, PF, Gratuity, Group Insurance, Pension (NALCO Defined Contribution Pension Scheme 2025), Performance Linked Incentive Scheme, etc.

How to Apply for NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official NALCO website https://www.nalcoindia.com. Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. The online application is a 2-step process -

Step-I: Registration and profile creation

Step-II: Login with credentials, fill application form, upload documents, and make online payment of fee (if applicable). Candidates must carefully furnish all correct details as no change/edit will be allowed after submission. A candidate is allowed to apply for only one post; if multiple applications are submitted for a single post, the latest application will be considered and the rest rejected. If a candidate applies for multiple posts, the candidature will be summarily rejected. Before applying online, candidates must scan and keep ready: passport-size photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20–50 KB), signature (blue/black ink, 10–20 KB), left thumb impression, hand-written declaration, and all relevant certificates.

Documents to be Uploaded at the Time of Online Application:

  • Left Thumb Impression
  • Hand Written Declaration (in English, blue/black ink)
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Matriculation Certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Matriculation mark sheet) (PDF)
  • Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card / Passport / Driving Licence / Voter's Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Photo ID issued by Gazetted Officer) (PDF)
  • Educational Certificates - All mark sheets and certificates (Final or Provisional) of Class 10th, ITI, Graduation, Diploma (as applicable) (PDF)
  • Ex-Servicemen eligibility proof with declarations as per latest Government guidelines (if applicable) (PDF)
  • Valid Employment Exchange Registration Card
  • Valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence (for Sl. No. 1 - Operator HEMM post)
  • Valid Mining Foreman Certificate of Competency / Electrical Supervisor's Certificate of Competency / Mining Mate Certificate of Competency issued by DGMS (as applicable for the post applied for)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) with requisite endorsement
  • Latest SC / ST / Disability Certificate / OBC (NCL) Certificate / EWS - Income & Asset Certificate, issued on or after 01-04-2026, in prescribed format (PDF)
  • Experience Certificate (if applicable) in the format given at Annexure-IV, on letterhead of the Organisation, along with offer of appointment and last pay slip
  • Land Ousted candidates - all supporting documents including land documents, legal heir certificate, and affidavit in prescribed format (Annexure-III) on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 25/-

Apply Online at: https://www.nalcoindia.com → Career page → Current Openings → Recruitment of Non-Executive Personnel – M&R Complex, Damanjodi-2026 → View Advertisement → Click here to Apply Online

For any queries: https://ccrs.ibps.in or Toll-free Helpline No. 1800222366 or 18001034566 (09:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days except Saturday, Sunday, and holidays).

Important Instructions for NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • A candidate is allowed to apply for only one post - applications for multiple posts will result in summary rejection of all applications.
  • Only full-time qualifications from recognized institutes will be considered; ITI/Diploma/B.Sc. must be in the specific branch/trade prescribed for the post.
  • All qualifications and experience must have been acquired on or before the closing date of application (10-06-2026).
  • OBC (NCL) certificate must be issued on or after 01-04-2026 (Central List OBC only - State Government OBC lists are not followed).
  • EWS Income & Asset Certificate must be issued on or after 01-04-2026 based on FY 2025-26 income.
  • PwBD candidates must possess a Disability Certificate certifying minimum 40% disability issued as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017. Only permanent (non-temporary) disabilities are eligible for reservation and age relaxation.
  • Land Ousted candidates whose lands have been acquired for the NALCO project at Damanjodi must upload a valid Employment Preference Certificate - maximum age is 40 years as on 10-06-2026.
  • Employees of PSUs/Government organizations must apply through proper channel and produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of document verification.
  • Candidates working in PSUs/Government organizations who fail to produce NOC will not be considered for appointment; their application will be subject to submission of original release order.
  • Application fee once paid shall neither be refunded under any circumstances nor held in reserve for any other recruitment or selection.
  • No documents/certificates and application forms are required to be sent by post.
  • Signature / hand written declaration in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • Electronic gadgets including mobile phones, smartwatches, etc. are not permitted inside the CBT examination hall - carrying them may lead to criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form during any stage of recruitment will render the candidate ineligible.
  • Any dispute with regard to this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Cuttack (Odisha) only.
  • NALCO does not seek payment of any kind other than the above-mentioned application fee - candidates are cautioned against fraud.

The latest Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Recruitment 2026 has been announced for Professor (Teaching Faculty – Medical Specialties) posts! Published on 19 May 2026 at www.esic.gov.in, this new recruitment drive offers 118 openings for eligible candidates. Applicants within the age group of up to 50 years (relaxations as applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/ESIC employees) and possessing the required medical or postgraduate qualifications can apply offline via the prescribed application form from now until 27 July 2026 (03 August 2026 for remote area candidates). Find all details about the ESIC Professor new vacancy 2026, including eligibility, application procedure, and notification PDF here

FOLLOW US

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The detailed notification titled “Recruitment of Teaching Faculty (Professors) in ESIC PGIMSRs and ESIC Medical Colleges on Direct Recruitment Basis” has been released by ESIC Headquarters, New Delhi. The notification provides complete information about specialty-wise vacancies, identified posts for PwBD, age limit, pay scale, educational qualifications, experience requirements, selection procedure, application fee, concessions/relaxations and the prescribed application form. Candidates must read the notification thoroughly before applying to ensure they meet all eligibility conditions.

  • Download ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organization Name Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Administrative Ministry Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
Post Name Professor (Teaching Faculty – Medical Specialties)
Mode of Recruitment Direct Recruitment (Interview‑based)
Total Vacancies 118 Professor posts across various specialties
Pay Scale Pay Level‑13 in Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,23,100 – 2,15,900) plus Non‑Practicing Allowance (NPA) and other admissible allowances
Job Location ESIC PGIMSRs and ESIC Medical Colleges across various States; liable to posting anywhere in India
Application Mode Offline – via prescribed application form sent by Speed Post/file:2
Selection Mode Interview by ESIC Selection Board; shortlisting based on experience if applications are large
Official Website https://www.esic.gov.in

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Vacancy Details

ESIC proposes to fill a total of 118 Professor posts in various specialties with category‑wise breakup as given below. Reserved vacancies include backlog vacancies of 11 SC, 6 ST and 23 OBC posts, and 8 posts are reserved for PwBD under categories (a), (b), (c) and (d & e) as per DoPT guidelines.

5 Dermatology 1
6 Emergency Medicine 6
7 Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) 5
8 General Medicine 8
9 General Surgery 8
10 Microbiology 7

12 Orthopedics 8

14 Pediatrics 6
15 Pathology 6
16 Pharmacology 5
17 Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation 2
18 Physiology 5

  Total 118

Out of the total, 8 posts are reserved for PwBD across categories (a) – blindness and low vision, (b) – deaf and hard of hearing, (c) – locomotor disability and related conditions, and (d & e) – autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness and multiple disabilities.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Notification 19 May 2026
Last Date for Receipt of Application (All India) 27 July 2026
Last Date for Remote Area Candidates 03 August 2026 (for candidates from NE States, J&K Ladakh division, specified HP districts, Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep etc.)

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must ensure that they satisfy all eligibility conditions relating to nationality, age, educational qualifications and teaching experience as of the closing date of receipt of applications.

Criteria Details
Nationality / Citizenship Candidate must be a citizen of India; certain categories of Nepal, Bhutan, Tibetan refugees and PIO from specified countries may also apply, subject to Government of India eligibility certificate.
Age Limit (UR / EWS) Not exceeding 50 years for Professor as on closing date of applications (27.07.2026 for most candidates).
Age Relaxation Up to 5 years for ESIC / Government servants; 5 years for SC/ST; 3 years for OBC; 10 years for PwBD (with cumulative maximum as per rules); additional relaxations for Ex‑Servicemen as per Government orders.
Educational Qualification – Medical Candidates
  • A recognised medical qualification included in First or Second Schedule or Part‑II of Third Schedule to IMC Act 1956, fulfilling Section 13(3) conditions where applicable.
  • Postgraduate qualification – MD/MS or equivalent in the concerned subject or allied discipline.
Educational Qualification – Non‑Medical Candidates Postgraduate degree (Master’s) in concerned subject/allied discipline and a Doctorate degree (PhD) from a recognised University in the respective subject/allied discipline, as per MCI/NMC “Minimum Qualifications for Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations”.
Teaching Experience
  • Four years’ teaching experience as Reader/Associate Professor in a recognised medical college in the concerned specialty; OR
  • Three years’ teaching experience as Associate Professor in the concerned specialty, with at least four research publications in indexed/national journals as first author, of which minimum two are during Associate Professor tenure.
Experience Recognition Teaching experience must be recognised by Medical Council of India/National Medical Commission or relevant statutory body; experience as General Duty Medical Officer is not counted.
PwBD Eligibility Only persons with minimum 40% benchmark disability in notified categories are eligible for PwBD reservation and age relaxation; only disabilities identified as suitable for each specialty as per the notification will be considered.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Pay Scale & Emoluments

Selected candidates will be appointed in Pay Level‑13 of the 7th CPC pay matrix with Non‑Practicing Allowance and other admissible benefits.

  • Basic Pay: Level‑13 (Rs. 1,23,100 – 2,15,900) in the pay matrix.
  • Allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA), Non‑Practicing Allowance (NPA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance and other allowances as per Central Government/ESIC rules.
  • Career Prospects: Promotional avenues available under DACP guidelines; opportunities for academic and research growth within ESIC medical institutions.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Application Fee

Application fee is payable via Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque only, in favour of “ESI Fund Account No. 2” payable at Delhi.

Category Application Fee
General / OBC / EWS / ESIC & Departmental Male Candidates Rs. 500/- (non‑refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD / Women (all categories) / Ex‑Servicemen No Fee

Fee once paid will not be refunded in any circumstances and applications without the prescribed fee (where applicable) will be rejected without correspondence.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be made on the basis of an Interview conducted by the ESIC Selection Board, with possible shortlisting based on experience.

  • If the number of applications is large, ESIC may shortlist candidates for interview based on teaching experience beyond the minimum required level (Associate Professor/Reader or above) as per Recruitment Rules.
  • Category‑wise minimum qualifying marks in interview: UR/EWS – 50, OBC – 45, SC/ST/PwBD – 40 out of 100 marks.
  • Tie‑breaking: older candidate by age is preferred; if still tied, earlier date of passing essential PG degree; if still tied, earlier date of completion of internship is considered.
  • A Reserve List may be maintained as per UPSC‑like provisions.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Age Relaxation & Reservation Notes

ESIC follows Government of India rules on age relaxation, community reservation and PwBD concessions.

  • SC/ST – up to 5 years; OBC – up to 3 years; PwBD – up to 10 years (maximum age on closing date not exceeding 56 years), with cumulative relaxation for SC/ST/OBC PwBD as per norms.
  • Ex‑Servicemen and ECOs/SSCOs – age relaxation up to 5 years subject to conditions on length of service and release certificates.
  • Only candidates belonging to castes/communities in the Central List of SC/ST/OBC and having valid, current certificates in the prescribed format will get reservation benefits; multiple applications in different categories will lead to rejection.

How to Apply – ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted offline only in the prescribed application form attached with the notification. No online application facility is available for this recruitment.

Step‑by‑Step Offline Application Process:

  1. Download and print the official notification and Application Form for “Professor in ESI Corporation‑2026” from ESIC website or your job portal.
  2. Fill the application form in BLOCK letters with accurate details such as specialty applied for, personal information, educational qualifications, teaching experience, registration details and publication list.
  3. Prepare a Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) in favour of “ESI Fund Account No. 2”, payable at Delhi, issued after the date of advertisement.
  4. Attach self‑attested copies of required documents (educational certificates, experience certificates, caste/EWS/PwBD certificates, proof of age, research publications, etc.) as per the checklist.
  5. Affix a recent self‑attested passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
  6. Place the filled and signed application form along with DD/Banker’s Cheque and enclosures in an envelope superscribed “Application for the post of Professor for Medical Institutions”.
  7. Send the application preferably by Speed Post to the address given below so as to reach on or before 27.07.2026 (03.08.2026 for specified remote areas).

Application Sending Address:

Postal Address Regional Office Delhi, ESI Corporation, DDA Complex‑cum‑Office, 3rd & 4th Floor, Rajendra Bhawan, Rajendra Place, New Delhi – 110008
DD/Banker’s Cheque Payable at Delhi

Applications received after the last date or without proper documents/fees will be rejected, and ESIC will not be responsible for postal delays.

Documents Required with ESIC Professor Application

Candidates must attach self‑attested copies of all relevant documents along with the application form.

  • Original Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque pinned on top of the application form with candidate’s name and address written on the reverse.
  • Recent passport size photograph (self‑attested) firmly pasted on the application form.
  • Matriculation/10th certificate or mark sheet indicating Date of Birth; in some cases, school leaving certificate for TN & Kerala.
  • Degree certificates and mark sheets of all academic years (MBBS, PG, PhD etc.); provisional certificates accepted if final degree is awaited.
  • Experience certificates from Heads of Organisations clearly mentioning post, period, pay and nature of duties, and specifying recognition as teaching experience by MCI/NMC or relevant body.
  • Certificates/testimonials supporting research publications and academic achievements.
  • Category certificates: SC/ST/OBC/EWS in prescribed Central Government format; OBC non‑creamy layer declaration; EWS Income & Asset certificate.
  • PwBD certificate in prescribed format for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • Documents for age relaxation (Ex‑Servicemen, Central/UT Govt employees etc.) in the prescribed formats.
  • Any other supporting documents for claims made in the application (name change, etc.).

Important Instructions for ESIC Professor Applicants

  • Eligibility (age, qualifications, experience etc.) is calculated with reference to the closing date of applications – 27.07.2026 for most candidates.
  • Mere submission of application or call for interview does not confer any right to appointment; candidature remains provisional until verification.
  • Incomplete/unsigned applications, or those not in prescribed proforma, without required documents, fee, or received after the last date will be rejected without communication.
  • Any false statement or suppression of material information can lead to cancellation of candidature/appointment at any stage.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation as per ESIC rules and are liable to be posted anywhere in India; state preferences are only indicative and not binding.

BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

All candidates will undergo the recruitment process in the following sequence: (i) Written Examination, (ii) Physical Efficiency Test (PET) including physical measurements and Trade Test (TT) where applicable, (iii) Primary Medical Examination (PME) and Document Verification (DV), and (iv) Induction/Joining. The PET and TT are qualifying in nature - final merit is based solely on written exam marks, subject to qualifying PET, TT, and clearing PME. Minimum passing marks in written exam: 50% for UR/EWS/OBC; 40% for SC/ST. Trade test requires minimum 40% marks to qualify.

Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Candidate must complete 1.6 km (1 mile) run in 10 minutes. PwBD, ESM, Ex-Agniveers, and departmental re-appointment candidates are exempt from PET.

Competition Level Analysis for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

The competition level for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 is expected to be moderate to high. The recruitment is restricted to Male candidates only, which reduces the applicant pool compared to open-gender recruitments. However, 899 vacancies across technical/trade posts will attract a large number of ITI-qualified and Matriculation-level candidates, especially for high-vacancy posts like Store Keeper Technical (300) and Operator Communication (261). The written exam followed by PET and Trade Test provides multiple elimination stages, but candidates with relevant ITI trade certificates and physical fitness will have a clear advantage. Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveers get significant age relaxation and weightage, which makes certain trades more competitive in that segment.

The key differentiator here is the offline application process - many eligible candidates may miss out due to postal delays or incorrect application format, effectively reducing actual competition at the written exam stage. Candidates who submit complete and correct applications well before the deadline and prepare trade-specific written exam syllabi will have a significant edge.

Who should NOT apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Female candidates - this recruitment is strictly for Indian National Males only.
  • Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational/technical qualification as on the closing date of application; those awaiting final exam results are not eligible.
  • Candidates outside the age band 18-27 years as on 01 Jun 2026 (except those eligible for applicable category-based relaxation).
  • OBC candidates from the Creamy Layer - they are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation and must apply as UR/General category.
  • Candidates who cannot meet the region-wise physical standards (height, chest, weight) as physical fitness is mandatory for induction.
  • Candidates with permanent medical conditions listed as grounds for permanent rejection (colour blindness for Drivers/Operators, cardiac conditions, gross myopia, etc.) who cannot pass the Primary Medical Examination at GREF Centre.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to be posted anywhere in India, especially in remote, high-altitude, or difficult terrain areas in Northern and Eastern regions.
  • Candidates who cannot arrange and send a physical application form with photograph, thumb impression, signature, fee e-receipt, and attested copies by post to Pune - there is no online application mode.
  • Candidates with tattoos on any body part other than the inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist) or reverse palm - tattoos on other parts lead to disqualification at PME.
  • Ex-servicemen who have already joined Govt civil service using ESM benefits and are claiming ESM status again - such candidates are treated as civilian employees.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Not printing the application form on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card on both sides of a single paper as mandated - non-standard paper leads to rejection.
  • Applying without attaching the e-receipt copy of the application fee paid via SBI Collect; no other payment mode is accepted and missing receipt causes rejection.
  • Sending the application from a wrong/old address instead of present postal address - applications posted from wrong address are rejected to prevent fraudulent claims of 60-day receipt benefit.
  • Not superscribing the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR (NAME OF TRADE/POST) Under Category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM/CPL)" as required - unlabelled envelopes may be misdirected.
  • Mismatch between name in application and name in Matriculation certificate - even a dropped or added part of the name requires a Gazette Notification; otherwise candidature is summarily cancelled.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post with different details or photographs - this results in lifetime debarment from all GREF examinations.
  • OBC/EWS certificate dated older than one year from the closing date - OBC and EWS certificates must be fresh (not older than one year as on closing date) and in the prescribed Central Govt format.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post/trade using the same envelope - each post requires a separate application with separate fee in a separate envelope.
  • Not carrying the minimum 12 passport-size photographs (same as pasted on application and admit card) to all subsequent recruitment stages - shortage of photos causes disruption at PET/TT/PME stages.
  • Ignoring the trade-specific syllabus and treating the written exam as a general knowledge test - each post has a distinct subject-wise syllabus and candidates must prepare trade-specific topics.

How to Apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply offline only; no online application mode is available. Application form and admit card must be downloaded from the official BRO website (www.bro.gov.in) and filled in English or Hindi only, in capital letters. The application form must be printed on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card printed on both sides of a single paper. Candidates must first pay the application fee online via SBI Collect portal and attach the e-receipt copy. Candidates applying for more than one post must send separate applications with separate fee in separate envelopes. Candidates are strongly advised to send applications well before the closing date and not wait for the last day - GREF Centre will not be responsible for postal delays.

Candidates should read the detailed instructions and guidelines available at https://bfsissc.com before applying.

  • Left hand thumb impression at the prescribed place on application form and admit card
  • Signature of candidate at the prescribed place

  • NCC certificate copies (B or C grade), sports certificate, or relationship certificate for Sons of Serving/Ex-GREF personnel - for claiming weightage marks
  • Proof of residence/domicile (for correct physical standards region)
  • Any certificate in language other than Hindi or English must be enclosed with an attested Hindi/English translation by a Group A Gazetted Officer

Important Instructions for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Male Indian Nationals can apply; Female candidates are not eligible.
  • Application form and/or admit card without signature, without photograph, or without thumb impression will be summarily rejected - no communication will be done for rejected applications.
  • Candidates must ensure their Aadhaar Card photo is current (not older than 2-3 years from written exam date) and address/phone is updated; outdated Aadhaar may prevent entry to the exam.
  • Son of Serving / Ex-GREF staff should write father's GS No., Rank, and Name on top of the application in red ink with a photocopy of relationship certificate, to claim the 15% weightage benefit.
  • Casual Paid Labours (CPL) of GREF who have worked for 179 days in the last one year and are on the Muster Roll on the date of advertisement publication get 10% additional weightage - attach experience certificate signed by OC unit, countersigned by Commander BRTF and verified by Accounts Officer.

  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to reservation; they should apply under UR category.
  • Candidates serving in other Government Departments must apply through proper channel sufficiently in advance; applications not received by due date through proper channel will be rejected.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, and all electronic/communication devices are strictly NOT ALLOWED inside GREF Centre, Pune campus during any recruitment process.
  • A candidate who absents himself during any recruitment activity for which he has been called will have his candidature cancelled automatically - he will not be allowed to appear for further stages.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores in examination; no correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this Advertisement shall fall within the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi.
  • Impersonation or submission of forged documents leads to debarment from all GREF examinations for life/2 years and legal action. GREF has not appointed any agent or coaching centre for action on its behalf - SELECTION WILL BE DONE PURELY ON MERIT IN A TRANSPARENT MANNER.
  • Vacancies are liable to increase/decrease/cancel at any stage without notice due to unforeseen situations.
  • All revisions/corrigendum will be hosted on the BRO website only - candidates should visit www.bro.gov.in regularly.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Selection Process

The selection process comprises an online AFCAT exam, followed by Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) testing, medical examination and final merit list.

Stage 1 - AFCAT Online Examination

Exam Subject Duration No. of Questions Maximum Marks
AFCAT General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability, Reasoning & Military Aptitude Test. 2 Hours (120 Minutes) 100 300

Each correct answer carries 3 marks, each wrong answer attracts a penalty of 1 mark, and no marks are awarded for unattempted questions. The paper is in English only, and normalisation of marks is applied when multiple shifts are conducted.

Stage 2 - Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) Testing

  • Stage‑I: Officer Intelligence Rating Test and Picture Perception & Discussion Test on Day 1; this is a screening stage.
  • Stage‑II: Psychological tests, Group Tests and Personal Interview over the next days for Stage‑I qualified candidates.
  • CPSS: Computerised Pilot Selection System for Flying Branch candidates (once‑in‑a‑lifetime test; CPSS/PABT failures are ineligible for Flying Branch).

Stage 3 - Medical Examination & Final Merit

Candidates recommended by AFSB and found medically fit by the appropriate medical board are considered for training strictly in order of merit and branch‑wise vacancies. The final merit list is based on combined marks of AFCAT (where applicable) and AFSB.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Exam Pattern & Syllabus

The AFCAT paper is of graduation‑level standard (except Numerical Ability, which is matriculation level) and tests a mix of aptitude and knowledge.

  • English: Comprehension, error detection, sentence completion, synonyms/antonyms, cloze test, idioms & phrases, analogy, sentence rearrangement, one‑word substitution, homonyms.
  • General Awareness: History, Geography, Sports, National & International Organisations, Art & Culture, Personalities, Environment & Ecology, Polity, Economy, Basic Science, Science & Technology, Current Affairs, Defence.
  • Numerical Ability: Fractions, Time & Work, Average, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Ratio & Proportion, Interest, Time & Distance, Area & Perimeter, Probability, Number System, Mixture & Allegation, Squares/Cubes, HCF & LCM, Mensuration, Heights & Distances, Statistics.
  • Reasoning & Military Aptitude: Verbal and Non‑Verbal Reasoning.

An online practice test is available on the IAF AFCAT website.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Training, Pay & Allowances

Candidates recommended by AFSBs and found medically fit are detailed for training at Air Force Training Establishments based on merit and branch.

  • Training Date & Duration: Training is scheduled to commence in the first week of July 2027; duration is approximately 62 weeks for Flying and Ground Duty (Technical) branches and 50 weeks for Ground Duty (Non‑Technical).
  • Stipend during Training: Flight Cadets receive a fixed stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month during one year of training (as per 7th CPC matrix).
  • Pay on Commissioning: Flying Officer - Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500) plus applicable MSP and allowances as per branch and posting.
  • Insurance: Officers are covered under Air Force Group Insurance Society (AFGIS), with Rs. 1.25 crore cover (on contribution) for death in service and Air Veterans Insurance Cover after retirement for eligible PC/SSC officers.

How to Apply for Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the AFCAT website; no other mode is accepted. Aadhaar Card is mandatory for online registration, and candidates should use valid email ID and mobile number, which must remain active throughout the selection process.

Step‑by‑Step Process (AFCAT Entry):

  1. Visit the official AFCAT website https://afcat.edcil.co.in and read the advertisement and instructions carefully.
  2. Click on the sign‑up/registration link and enter full name, mobile number and email ID, then verify via OTP on email and mobile.
  3. Agree to the declaration, submit the registration form and obtain the system‑generated User ID and Password sent to registered email and mobile.
  4. Login with User ID and Password, click on “Go to Application”, and fill personal details, communication details, qualification details, course preferences and other required fields.
  5. Upload scanned images of recent passport size colour photograph (100-200 KB), signature (80-150 KB), thumb impression (50-100 KB) and live image capture as per specified formats.
  6. Carefully verify all details using “Preview” and then proceed to pay the examination fee of Rs. 550/- + GST (for AFCAT entry only) through online payment gateway (Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, UPI etc.).
  7. After successful payment and submission, download and print the final submitted application form for future reference.

Applicants should apply well before the last date to avoid last‑minute issues; once submitted, the application cannot be edited, and additional applications against the same Aadhaar will result in only the latest being considered.

Important Instructions for AFCAT 02/2026 Candidates

  • Candidates must ensure eligibility for the branch(es) they apply for; incorrect information at any stage leads to cancellation of candidature.
  • Use of unfair means or possession of prohibited items (mobile phones, smart watches, electronic devices, study material etc.) inside the exam hall will result in cancellation and debarment from future AFCATs.

Competition Level Analysis for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The competition level for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very high due to 7150 seats being offered at the all-India level and the exam being open to any graduate, including those already preparing for bank and SSC exams. While the written test is of easy to moderate difficulty and slightly below SBI Clerk level, the large number of serious aspirants in high-population states like Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana will push state-wise and category-wise cut-offs upward.

In practical terms, each seat is likely to attract dozens to over a hundred candidates in major states, making speed, accuracy, and sectional balance crucial to clearing the single-stage written exam followed by the local language test. However, the effective competition reduces at later stages because some candidates will fail to qualify the language test or be filtered out at the document verification, CIBIL, Aadhaar, and medical fitness stages, and SBI will finally select candidates strictly on state-wise and category-wise merit from those who clear all stages.

Who should NOT apply for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates looking for a permanent job in SBI; this is only a 1‑year apprenticeship with no guarantee of absorption or regular employment.
  • Candidates who already completed any Apprenticeship (in SBI or any other organisation) or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act.
  • Candidates outside the age band 20–28 years as on the cut-off date (even 1 day younger/older is not eligible, except notified relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD).
  • Aspirants who do not have a Graduation degree from a recognised University/Institute by the specified date.
  • Candidates not fluent in the notified local language of the State/UT (reading, writing, speaking, understanding), and who are unlikely to clear the language test or do not have 10th/12th proof.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to register on the NAPS portal before applying, as this is a mandatory prerequisite for SBI Apprentice.
  • Candidates with serious CIBIL/loan/credit‑card defaults who have not regularised or repaid outstanding dues by the time of offer; such profiles are normally rejected in bank recruitments.
  • Ex‑Servicemen / Disabled Ex‑Servicemen, where the notification clearly states no engagement / no reservation for them under Apprentice.
  • PwBD candidates whose disability type falls under “likely to improve” (temporary disability) where reservation benefits may not apply as per notification conditions.
  • Candidates who cannot produce valid Aadhaar (except where exempted, e.g., certain North‑Eastern states with alternate ID allowed).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying in a wrong State or language where you cannot comfortably read, write and speak the specified local language.
  • Entering wrong category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR); category cannot be changed later and mismatch with certificates at DV can lead to cancellation.
  • OBC candidates from creamy layer applying as OBC instead of UR; only non‑creamy OBCs with valid, recent certificate get reservation.
  • Uploading blurred/incorrect photo, signature, thumb impression or declaration (wrong size, wrong format, someone else’s handwriting) leading to rejection at scrutiny.
  • Using invalid or inactive mobile number/email ID, causing failure to receive OTPs, registration details, call letters or further communication.
  • Submitting multiple applications for different states or with different details; SBI usually accepts only the last complete application and may forfeit extra fees.
  • Ignoring negative marking and over‑attempting in the exam, which can sharply reduce your score despite high attempts.
  • Not reading the clause that this is not regular employment, and later protesting about absorption or permanent posting after apprenticeship ends.

How to Apply for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online; no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must first mandatorily register on the NAPS portal (https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and read the detailed guidelines on https://bfsissc.com before applying online through the SBI website.

Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be kept active till declaration of results. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date and not wait till the last date.

Documents Required to be Scanned and Uploaded (as per Annexure-I):

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 200×230 pixels; 20 KB–50 KB; JPEG)
  • Signature with black ink on white paper (140×60 pixels; 10 KB–20 KB; JPEG)
  • Left Thumb Impression on white paper with black or blue ink (240×240 pixels; 20 KB–50 KB; JPEG/JPG)
  • Handwritten Declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels; 50 KB–100 KB; JPEG/JPG) — in candidate's own handwriting
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile phone (to be uploaded at the time of online application)

Documents to be Produced at the time of Examination / Document Verification / Engagement:

  • Call Letter (downloaded from Bank's website) along with photo identity proof (Passport / Aadhaar / PAN Card / Driving License / Voter's Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Identity Card issued by School or College / Gazetted Officer in official letterhead) in original and self-attested photocopy
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed Government of India format (for SC/ST candidates) — to be submitted at the time of engagement if called for
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in prescribed Government of India format, issued during the period 01-04-2026 to the date of joining (for OBC candidates)
  • Income and Asset Certificate issued by Competent Authority in the format prescribed by Government of India, valid for the year 2026-27 (for EWS candidates)
  • Disability Certificate in prescribed format issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines (for PwBD candidates)
  • Educational qualification certificates and marksheets (Graduation onwards)

Printout of Application Form is NOT to be sent to SBI. No Hard Copy of the Call Letter for Online Written Examination will be sent by post. Candidates must appear for the test at their own cost; SBI will not pay or reimburse any such expenses.

Apply Online at: https://www.sbi.co.in/careers or https://sbi.bank.in/careers

For queries: Call 022-22820427 (11:00 AM to 06:00 PM on working days) or visit https://cgrs.ibps.in — mention "Engagement of Apprentice in SBI" in the subject.

Important Instructions for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • THIS IS NOT AN EMPLOYMENT IN THE BANK. NOR IS THE SAME CONTRACT EMPLOYMENT. Candidates engaged as Apprentice will NOT be treated as "employees" of SBI and will not be entitled to receive any benefits available for employees of the Bank.
  • SBI shall have no obligation to offer regular employment to Apprentices during and/or after the completion of the Apprenticeship period. After completion, candidates will be relieved from the respective work area.
  • Candidates can apply for engagement in one State only and can appear for the examination only once under this engagement project.
  • Mandatory registration on NAPS portal (https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) before applying online on SBI website is required.
  • No Ex-Servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an Apprentice and there is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Apprentice Engagement.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to reservation/relaxation; they should apply as General or General (LD/VI/HI/d&e) as applicable.
  • Change of category will not be permitted after registration of online application.
  • Candidates with CIBIL default record (unpaid loans/credit card dues) are not eligible for engagement until dues are regularized/repaid.
  • All candidates (except Northeastern State candidates) must produce Aadhaar Number before engagement/contract signing.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted; in case of multiple applications, only the last valid completed application will be retained and fee paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.
  • PwBD candidates with disability conditions falling under "likely to improve" (temporary disability) category are not eligible for reservation.
  • PwBD candidates eligible for scribe facility: candidates with 40% or more disability having physical limitation to write are eligible. Scribe must be arranged by the candidate at his/her own cost. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination is allowed (whether availing scribe or not) for eligible PwBD candidates.
  • Candidates are advised to keep their registered email ID/mobile active for receiving call letters/advices etc.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, pagers, earphones or any other electronic/communication devices are not allowed inside the examination premises.
  • All revisions/corrigendum (if any) will be hosted on the Bank's website only — candidates should visit regularly.
  • No request for change of examination centre shall be entertained. No Travel Expenses will be reimbursed/paid by SBI.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be Mumbai only.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the selection process partly/entirely at any stage.

SBI Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date 30.04.2026. Teaching and training experience will not be counted for eligibility. The relevant experience certificate from the employer must specifically confirm that the candidate had experience in the related field as required. In cases where the degree/diploma certificate does not specify the field of specialization, a certificate from the concerned university/college specifically mentioning the specialization must be produced.

Educational Qualification and Experience

Qualification / Experience Details
Mandatory Educational Qualification Graduate (any discipline) from Government recognized University or Institution AND Certification in Forex Operations from IIBF (Certificate should be dated on or before 30.04.2026)
Preferred Qualification Certificate for Documentary Credit Specialists (CDCS) / Certificate in Trade Finance / Certificate in International Banking (Certificate should be dated on or before 30.04.2026)
Mandatory Experience Minimum 2 years’ post-essential academic qualification experience in Trade Finance processing in Supervisory/Official role in any Scheduled Commercial Bank
Specific Skills Required Outstanding communication, presentation and processing skills

SBI Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Age is calculated as on 30.04.2026. Cumulative age relaxation will not be available. Candidates seeking age relaxation are required to submit copies of necessary certificate(s) at the time of interview, if shortlisted. No change in category of any candidate is permitted after online registration; no correspondence/email/phone will be entertained in this regard.

Category Age Limit / Relaxation
Unreserved (UR) 23 to 32 years (as on 30.04.2026)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation
SC / ST 5 years relaxation
PwBD (UR / EWS) 10 years relaxation
PwBD (OBC) 13 years relaxation
PwBD (SC / ST) 15 years relaxation

SBI Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Application fee and Intimation Charges are non-refundable and must be paid online through the payment gateway integrated with the application (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking). Transaction charges for online payment, if any, will be borne by the candidate. Application fee once paid will NOT be refunded on any account nor can it be adjusted for any other examination or selection in future. In case of multiple applications, fee paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.

Category Application Fee
General / EWS / OBC Rs. 750/- (Rupees Seven Hundred Fifty only)
SC / ST / PwBD Nil (No fee / intimation charges)

SBI Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be on the basis of Shortlisting and Interview. Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience will not vest any right to candidate for being called for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters. The decision of the Bank to call the candidates for interview shall be final. Interview will carry 100 marks; qualifying marks will be decided by the Bank. Merit list for selection will be prepared in descending order on the basis of scores obtained in interview only. In case of tie, candidates will be ranked according to their age in descending order. Intimation/Call Letter for Interview will be sent by email or uploaded on Bank’s website only - no hard copy will be sent.

Stage Details
Stage 1 Shortlisting (based on qualification, suitability, and experience as decided by the Bank’s shortlisting committee)
Stage 2 Interview (100 marks; qualifying marks decided by the Bank)
Merit List Prepared in descending order of interview scores; tie-breaking by age in descending order
Probation Period 6 months (as per Bank’s extant recruitment policy)

Grade, Pay Scale & Perquisites

Grade Probation Period Pay Scale Perquisites
Middle Management Grade Scale – II (MMGS-II) 6 Months Rs. 64820-2340/1-67160-2680/10-93960 DA, HRA, CCA, Provident Fund, NPS (Contributory Pension Fund), Leave Fare Concession (LFC), Medical Facility, and other perquisites as per rules in force from time to time

SBI Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 - Job Profile & Key Responsibility Areas

The Trade Finance Officer (MMGS-II) position is in the Specialist cadre with no provision for conversion into General cadre. Suggested place of posting is Hyderabad and Kolkata; however, selected candidates may be posted anywhere in India at the sole discretion of the Bank. Requests for transfer/allotment to any centre other than Kolkata/Hyderabad shall not be entertained.

Area Details
Job Profile Trade Finance Document Scrutiny (LC/Collections/Bank Guarantees) for compliance with Bank/RBI/ICC/FEDAI/regulatory guidelines; Processing of Trade Finance and Forex transactions at a centralized location; Reconciliation of Trade Finance and Forex related entries in Bank’s Trade Finance, Forex and CBS systems and IDPMS/EDPMS; Any other tasks related to Bank’s Trade Finance and International Business back-office operations.
Key Responsibility Areas Accurate and efficient processing of all allotted Trade Finance and/or Forex transactions within benchmarked TAT; Tracking and ensuring periodic activities including maturities, payments, prompt follow-up, customer reconciliation; Timely reconciliation of related accounts/systems; Work closely with all stakeholders to maintain agreed customer TAT; Ensure adherence to all regulatory/bank/ICC/FEDAI guidelines; Participation in RCSA, BCOR, process review and training activities; Timely submission/compliance of all Audit Reports; Any other activity as directed by Team Leaders and Department/Branch Heads.

How to Apply for SBI Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the link available on SBI’s official website https://sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings. No other mode of application will be entertained. Hard copy of application and other documents need not be sent to this office. The process of registration is completed only when fee is deposited with the Bank through online mode on or before the last date. Candidates are advised to apply online well before the closing date and not to wait till the last date to avoid any technical issues.

Candidates must upload all required documents at the time of online application; failure to upload documents will result in candidature not being considered for shortlisting/interview. After expiry of the window for online application, no change/correction/modification will be allowed under any circumstances.

Documents to be Uploaded at the Time of Online Application:

  • Recent Photograph & Signature (JPEG)
  • Detailed Resume (PDF)
  • ID Proof (PDF)
  • Proof of Date of Birth (PDF)
  • Caste Certificate & PwBD Certificate (if applicable) (PDF)
  • Mandatory Educational Certificates: Degree Certificate (PDF)
  • Mandatory Certification in Forex Operations from IIBF (PDF)
  • Experience Certificates (mandatory) (PDF)
  • Preferred Certificate, if any (PDF)
  • Biodata Form (duly filled, signed & scanned - available on Bank’s career website under the advertisement) (PDF)
  • Form-16 / Offer Letter / Latest Salary Slip from current employer (PDF)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer (mandatory if working in Government Institute/Public Sector Unit/Public Sector Bank) (PDF)
  • Mandatory Undertaking (format available on Bank’s career page against Adv. No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/05) (PDF)

Apply Online at: https://sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings

Important Instructions for SBI Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Candidates must apply online only; hard copy of application and other documents need not be sent to SBI’s office.
  • The position of Trade Finance Officer (MMGS-II) shall remain in Specialist cadre and will have no provision for conversion into General cadre.
  • Teaching and training experience will not be counted for eligibility.
  • Candidates with any disciplinary proceedings pending or contemplated against them as on date will not be eligible to apply; an undertaking must be uploaded at the time of online application.
  • CIBIL: Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks/NBFCs/Financial Institutions including credit card dues and have not regularized/repaid their outstanding till the date of issuance of offer of recruitment by the Bank shall not be eligible for appointment.
  • Candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices/Public Sector undertakings/Nationalized Banks must submit NOC from their employer at the time of interview, failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • In case of multiple applications for the same post, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained; fee paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.
  • OBC certificate containing the ‘non-creamy layer’ clause, issued during the period 01.04.2026 to the date of interview, must be submitted by OBC candidates if called for interview.
  • EWS candidates not in possession of “Income & Asset Certificate” for FY2025-26 on or before closure of online application date should apply under “UR Category” only.
  • Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed airfare (economy class, shortest route, to-and-fro) up to a maximum of Rs. 10,000/- on submission of original flight tickets/invoice and boarding pass.
  • All changes/updates/revisions/corrigendum/results will be hosted on the Bank’s website only; no separate intimation will be issued.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai; Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Candidates are advised to keep their email ID/mobile number active till the declaration of result and issuance of call letters on final selection.
  • SBI does not endorse, authorize or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection or insider guidance. Candidates must rely solely on information available on SBI’s official career portal.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be based on Written Test followed by Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on written test performance will be called for Personal Interview. Final selection will be based on overall performance in both stages. Written Examination carries 70% weightage and Personal Interview carries 30% weightage in the final merit list. There will be no sectional cut-off in the written test. Exim Bank will analyse responses to detect patterns of similarity - if copying is inferred, candidature will be cancelled.

Written test carries 70% weightage; Interview carries 30% weightage in final merit.

Stage 2 - Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written test performance will be called for Personal Interview at Mumbai or New Delhi. Candidates must produce original degree certificates, caste, experience and other relevant certificates at the time of interview. Candidates already in service must carry a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager (Information Security) Recruitment 2026 - Pre-Recruitment Training

A pre-recruitment training will be organized for candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online/offline) will be intimated to candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared after the last date of registration.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.E./M.C.A. in Computer Science/IT/Electronics & Communication - degrees from other disciplines or part-time/distance/correspondence courses are strictly ineligible.
  • Candidates with aggregate marks below 60% in their qualifying degree - the 60% minimum is a hard eligibility condition.
  • Candidates who do not have at least 1 year of post-qualification experience in Information Security functions in a Scheduled Commercial Bank, All India Financial Institution, or other organization of repute - experience in unrelated IT roles does not qualify.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21 to 28 years as on 01-05-2026 (except those entitled to OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC Creamy Layer candidates expecting OBC reservation or age relaxation - they must apply as General.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting is at the Bank's requirement at any location in India including transfers to overseas offices with consent.
  • Candidates who cannot commit to the 5-year service bond of Rs. 3 lakh - this bond is mandatory and must be executed at the time of joining.
  • Candidates currently in government service who cannot produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their employer at the time of joining - they will not be allowed to join without it.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Uploading a signature in CAPITAL LETTERS - capital letter signatures are not accepted and will lead to rejection.
  • Not writing the handwritten declaration personally in English - if written by anyone else or in any other language, the application will be declared invalid.
  • Not uploading a live photograph via webcam/mobile at the time of filling the application - this is mandatory in addition to the static scanned photograph.
  • Uploading blurry, smudged, or unclear photograph, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration - such applications may be rejected; candidates should preview all uploads before final submission.
  • Not cross-checking that the name in the application exactly matches the name on the photo identity proof - any mismatch leads to denial of entry at the examination/interview; female candidates who have changed name post-marriage must be especially careful.
  • Clicking Back or Refresh during online fee payment - this may cause double charges; wait for server intimation after payment submission.

  • Not keeping the email ID and mobile number active till the end of the recruitment process - all communications including admit card, call letters, and results are sent only via email/SMS.
  • Not furnishing the CGPA conversion formula/letter from University/Institute if degree is CGPA-based - without this, the equivalent percentage cannot be verified and candidature may be rejected.
  • Waiting till the last date to apply - the Bank is not responsible for website outages or connectivity issues; candidates must apply well before 14-06-2026.

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 05 Management Trainee vacancies have been announced on Direct Recruitment basis across two disciplines. Reservation is applicable as per prevailing Government of India guidelines. Abbreviations: UR - Unreserved, OBC (NCL) - Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer), PwBD - Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. PwBD reservation is horizontal within overall vacancies; selected PwBD candidates will be adjusted against the category to which they belong. Only candidates with not less than 40% of relevant disability are eligible for PwBD reservation. SC/ST vacancies not notified in this advertisement. Reservations as per prevailing GoI guidelines.

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the date of eligibility. Only Indian Citizens are eligible to apply. Candidates having completed graduation and postgraduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance learning are NOT eligible. All qualifications must be from a University/Institution recognised/approved by Government / AICTE / UGC.

Post Essential Academic Qualification
Management Trainee - Human Resource Management (03 Posts) Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course) AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management (minimum 2-year full-time course) with minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in both Graduation and Post Graduation.
Management Trainee - Administration (02 Posts) Option 1: Minimum 60% in Graduation (3-year full-time) AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Hotel and Hospitality Management / Facilities Management or equivalent (2-year full-time), with minimum 60% in both Graduation and Post Graduation.

Option 2: Minimum 60% in B.Tech in Civil Engineering AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) in any discipline, both full-time, with minimum 60% marks.

Note: Candidates who have appeared in their final qualifying examinations and are awaiting results are eligible to appear in the Written Examination. However, the offer to join shall be subject to production of necessary documents evidencing successful completion of requisite qualification by 01-06-2026 or the joining date prescribed by the Bank (whichever is later). Candidates from universities/institutes awarding CGPA/GPA must furnish a letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination indicating the conversion formula from grades to percentage, if equivalent percentage is not mentioned in their marksheet.

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will comprise a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on performance in the Written Test will be called for Personal Interview. Final selection will be based on overall performance in both stages. No sectional cut-off will be applied in the Written Test; the final merit list will be drawn based on marks in Written Examination (out of 100 with 70% weightage) and Interview (out of 100 with 30% weightage).

Stage 1 - Written Test (Subjective)

Part Description Marks Duration
Part I Subject Matter Knowledge - HR / Administration (Compulsory Question) 40 02 hours 30 minutes
Part II Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions (HR / Administration) 60
Total 100

The Written Test is a Professional Knowledge - Subjective paper. There is no negative marking. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including time for verification and completion of various formalities. Candidates reporting late after the reporting time specified on the call letter will not be permitted to take the examination.

Stage 2 - Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted from the Written Test will be called for Personal Interview to be conducted in Mumbai and/or New Delhi. Candidates must carry original and photocopy of valid photo identity proof along with the Interview Call Letter. The Bank's decision on shortlisting and final selection shall be final and binding.

Competition Level Analysis for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

The competition level for Exim Bank MT Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very intense given that only 05 vacancies are on offer across two disciplines from a large pool of MBA/PGDBM graduates across India. The Bank being a premier financial institution under the Government of India makes this an exceptionally sought-after position among finance, HR, and administration postgraduates. The subjective Written Test format — unlike the MCQ-based bank exams — demands strong subject knowledge, analytical writing ability, and command over HR / Administration concepts rather than just speed and aptitude.

The low vacancy count means even marginal differences in written test scores will determine shortlisting for the interview round. Candidates with domain depth in HRM/Personnel Management (for MT-HRM) or Hotel/Facilities/Civil background with MBA (for MT-Administration) are better positioned. The Personal Interview carrying 30% of the final weightage means soft skills, subject clarity, and awareness of Exim Bank's functions and India's international trade ecosystem will be critical differentiators at the final stage.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who have completed their graduation or postgraduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance learning; they are categorically not eligible.
  • Candidates who do not hold a Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) in the relevant specialization with minimum 60% marks in both graduation and post graduation.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21-28 years as on 30-04-2026 (except as per OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer; they must apply as General candidates. OBC certificate must be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date).
  • Candidates who have defaulted in any loan repayment and/or whose name appears in CIBIL database as a defaulter.
  • Candidates unwilling to serve anywhere in India or unwilling to be transferred to offices outside India (with consent).
  • Candidates unwilling to execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the Bank for 1 year as MT and minimum 5 years as employee after absorption.
  • Currently serving employees of Government / PSU who cannot produce a proper Relieving Letter/Discharge Certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.
  • Candidates whose CGPA-based qualification does not include an equivalent percentage conversion letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if percentage is not mentioned in marksheet).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for MT-HRM without specialization in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management, or applying for MT-Administration without the prescribed qualification combinations.
  • Not checking whether your graduation and postgraduation are from a full-time regular programme; part-time/distance mode graduates are not eligible even if the university is recognized.
  • Entering less than 60% marks in either graduation or postgraduation; both must independently meet the 60% threshold.
  • OBC candidates applying with an expired caste certificate; OBC NCL certificate must be issued within one year prior to the last date of applying and must contain the non-creamy layer clause.
  • Uploading blurred/incorrect photo, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration; any mismatch or unclear document can lead to rejection.
  • Writing the handwritten declaration in capital letters or in a language other than English; both will render the application invalid.
  • Using an inactive or incorrect mobile number/email ID, causing missed notifications for call letters, exam updates, or interview communication.
  • Pressing the BACK or REFRESH button during the online payment process, which may result in double charge or payment failure.
  • Not noting down the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated at the time of registration; required for re-login if application is saved midway.
  • Submitting application without verifying that the name as filled in the form exactly matches the name on photo identity proof; any mismatch will lead to disqualification at the exam/interview stage.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only from 15 May 2026 to 14 June 2026 through the link available at https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers. No other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date and not wait till the last date. Before applying, candidates must scan and keep ready all required documents as per specifications mentioned in the notification.

Documents Required to be Scanned and Uploaded:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 200×230 pixels; 20 KB-50 KB; JPEG)
  • Signature with black ink on white paper (140×60 pixels; 10 KB-20 KB; JPEG) — not in CAPITAL LETTERS
  • Left Thumb Impression on white paper with black or blue ink (240×240 pixels; 200 DPI; 20 KB-50 KB; JPG/JPEG)
  • Handwritten Declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels; 200 DPI; 50 KB-100 KB; JPG/JPEG) — in candidate's own handwriting only, not in capital letters. Text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile phone (to be captured at the time of online application)
  • Consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation (PDF; 20 KB-500 KB)
  • Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree Certificate (PDF; 20 KB-500 KB)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable) (PDF; 20 KB-500 KB)

Documents to be Produced at the time of Written Examination / Personal Interview:

  • Call Letter (downloaded from Bank's website) along with original and photocopy of valid photo identity proof (PAN Card / Passport / Permanent Driving License / Voter's Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Aadhaar Card / E-Aadhaar / Employee ID / Bar Council Identity Card with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer or People's Representative on official letterhead)
  • Original Degree Certificates and Mark Sheets (Graduation and Post-Graduation)
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed format (for OBC candidates — must contain NCL clause, issued within one year prior to last date of applying)
  • Disability Certificate issued by authority as prescribed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 (for PwBD candidates)
  • In case of name change after passing High School — original Gazette notification / marriage certificate / affidavit in original
  • CGPA conversion letter from Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if equivalent percentage is not mentioned in marksheet)
  • Relieving Letter/Discharge Certificate from present employer (for candidates already in service — to be produced at the time of joining)

Note: Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid identity proof. Candidates must ensure the name on the Call Letter exactly matches the name on the photo identity proof.

Apply Online at: https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers

For queries: Regularly check https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers for details and updates. Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction of courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only.

Important Instructions for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • The application link will be live from 15 May 2026; no application in any other format or mode will be considered.
  • The registration process is complete only when fee is deposited through online mode on or before the last date; incomplete applications or applications without fee (except exempt categories) are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil all eligibility criteria before paying fee/submitting application; fees once paid will not be refunded even if the applicant is found ineligible.

  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories; details will be intimated to candidates who opt for it in the online application form.
  • PwBD candidates eligible for scribe facility must indicate the same in the online application form at the time of applying; subsequent requests may not be entertained. Scribe must be arranged by the candidate at their own cost. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination will be allowed for eligible PwBD candidates using a scribe.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination/interview hall.
  • No request for change of examination centre/venue/date/session will be entertained.
  • Candidates must carry the call letter and original photo identity proof to both the Written Test and Personal Interview without fail; absence of either will result in denial of entry.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

SECR Nagpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

SECR Nagpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be based on a merit list prepared for all candidates who apply against the notification. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of percentage of marks in Matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) plus ITI marks in the trade in which Apprenticeship is to be done. For candidates from boards like Board of Secondary Education Andhra Pradesh and Board of Public Examination Kerala (grade-based systems), SECR Nagpur Division will take the midpoint of the range of grades obtained, treating each subject as out of 100 marks for average calculation. Shortlisted candidates will be subject to verification of all original testimonials and appropriate medical examination. After selection, requests to change division/unit will not be entertained.

Role Snapshot
You will be the person our clients rely on to actually get them interviews. This is a high-ownership, execution-first role where you manage 10 or more clients at a time, each at different stages of their job search. Our clients are not freshers. Many are Directors, VPs, and senior professionals who expect sharp, thoughtful work. We have SOPs. You will follow them. But the SOPs do not make every decision for you. When a client is a VP of Engineering targeting a Head of Product role at a Series B, you need to know that the right person to reach out to is the CTO or a senior technical recruiter, not an HR coordinator. That kind of judgment is what this role runs on. Key responsibilities: 1. Manage an active portfolio of 10 or more clients simultaneously, each with their own target roles, timelines, and priorities. 2. Research and identify relevant job opportunities across LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and Glassdoor for each client based on their profile. 3. Find the right decision-makers at target companies while carefully matching seniority levels. 4. Source and verify recruiter and hiring manager email addresses using enrichment tools. 5. Set up and schedule personalized cold email outreach sequences and follow-ups for each client. 6. Manage and monitor client LinkedIn profiles, including activity, messaging, and profile presentation. 7. Conduct regular LinkedIn audits and share structured feedback and improvement recommendations. 8. Generate weekly or bi-weekly client reports covering outreach sent, opens, replies, interviews scheduled, and pipeline status. 9. Track each client’s application pipeline from saved to applied to interviewing and keep records updated. 10. Communicate proactively with clients when attention or input is required. 11. Flag patterns, blockers, or client issues to internal leads before they become problems. What we are looking for: 1. 1 to 3 years of experience in recruitment, HR tech, career services, client operations, executive assistance, or a similar field. 2. Strong understanding of the job search process and practical hiring workflows. 3. Strong written English skills for writing client-facing emails and reports. 4. Comfortable working with LinkedIn, spreadsheets, email clients, and new SaaS tools. 5. High ownership mindset with the ability to manage deliverables independently. 6. Ability to handle multiple clients and priorities simultaneously without missing deadlines. 7. Good understanding of corporate hierarchy and stakeholder targeting. 8. Previous startup experience is a strong plus. 9. Familiarity with ATS systems, cold email tools, or LinkedIn outreach is a strong plus. What good looks like at 90 days: 1. Managing a full client portfolio independently with minimal escalations. 2. Ensuring client reports and outreach activities are delivered consistently on time. 3. Proactively flagging edge cases and judgment calls instead of making assumptions or remaining silent. 4. Helping clients receive replies and schedule interviews successfully.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tag to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. Our Values: The Principles That Guide Us

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

  • We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
  • We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
  • We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
  • We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.

What You'll Achieve: A Glimpse into Your Contributions

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Transfer data from vendor websites and internal Verse systems to finance spreadsheets
  • Track profitability of new customers

What You'll Bring: The Skills and Experience Youâll Leverage

We believe that diverse experiences and backgrounds lead to better solutions. While we have an idea of what will help someone succeed in this role, we are open to being convinced by your unique story and skills. If you believe you can achieve the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply.

Core Skills & Experience:

  • Extremely high attention to detail and organization
  • Experience with data entry tasks
  • Ability to work with both speed and accuracy
  • Great communication, ability to learn new things and take feedback when provided by leaders

The Environment & Location:

  • This is a remote role
  • Working hours will be minimal at first (about 10 hours per week) but will likely grow over time. Work hours are fully flexible as long as you can attend occasional trainings during US business hours

Our Pledge for an Equitable Future

At Verse Medical, our mission is to deliver equitable, hospital-quality care to everyone, regardless of their background or where they live. We can only achieve this if our own team reflects the diversity of the patients we serve. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, where their contributions are valued, and where they can do their best work.
